source_zh_CN: 【上午九点。星见医院住院楼。瑞穗拖着一只轻巧的旅行箱，步履轻快地来到护士站。】
zh_CN: 【上午九点。星见医院住院楼。瑞穗拖着一只轻巧的旅行箱，步履轻快地来到护士站。】
en: [9:00 a.m., Hoshimi Hospital's inpatient building. Pulling a small suitcase, Mizuho walks briskly up to the nurses' station.]
“Good morning! I'm here to check in!”
“Good morning. Your name, please?”

source_zh_CN: 「支手瑞穗。今天入院，下周一开刀的那个！」
zh_CN: 「支手瑞穗。今天入院，下周一开刀的那个！」
en: “Mizuho Shite. I'm being admitted today, with surgery next Monday!”
[Asakura checks the booking and admission documents.]

source_zh_CN: 「支手小姐，确认到了。坂口医生已经安排好病房。」
zh_CN: 「支手小姐，确认到了。坂口医生已经安排好病房。」
en: “Found it, Miss Shite. Dr. Sakaguchi has your room ready.”

source_zh_CN: 「太好了！对了，我的房间离千早近吗？」
zh_CN: 「太好了！对了，我的房间离千早近吗？」
en: “Great! Oh, is my room near Chihaya's?”

source_zh_CN: 「仓本小姐还在恢复中。您的病房就在同一层。」
zh_CN: 「仓本小姐还在恢复中。您的病房就在同一层。」
en: “Miss Kuramoto is still recovering. Your room is on the same floor.”

source_zh_CN: 「完美！这样住院也不会无聊了。」
zh_CN: 「完美！这样住院也不会无聊了。」
en: “Perfect! Now I won't get bored here.”
“...You certainly seem lively.”

source_zh_CN: 「因为我身体很好呀！检查结果不也全都正常？」
zh_CN: 「因为我身体很好呀！检查结果不也全都正常？」
en: “Because I'm perfectly healthy! Weren't all my test results normal?”
“Yes. Your chart is quite clear about that.”

source_zh_CN: 「那就好。我可不想因为住院才把自己弄得病恹恹的。」
zh_CN: 「那就好。我可不想因为住院才把自己弄得病恹恹的。」
en: “Good. I don't want being in the hospital to make me all sickly.”

source_zh_CN: 「那从今天起，您就需要按住院患者的安排作息了。」
zh_CN: 「那从今天起，您就需要按住院患者的安排作息了。」
en: “From today, though, you'll need to follow the inpatient routine.”
“No problem! I'm great at cooperating.”

source_zh_CN: 「今天先办理入院、核对准备事项。周一早晨要按手术流程来，您到时候可能就没这么轻松了。」
zh_CN: 「今天先办理入院、核对准备事项。周一早晨要按手术流程来，您到时候可能就没这么轻松了。」
en: “Today we'll complete admission and review the preparations. On Monday morning, we'll follow the surgical schedule. You may not feel quite so relaxed then.”

source_zh_CN: 「朝仓护士也这么说？千早已经吓唬我好多次了。」
zh_CN: 「朝仓护士也这么说？千早已经吓唬我好多次了。」
en: “You too, Nurse Asakura? Chihaya's already tried scaring me so many times.”

source_zh_CN: 「我只是把要做的事情告诉您。」
zh_CN: 「我只是把要做的事情告诉您。」
en: “I'm simply explaining what we'll be doing.”

source_zh_CN: 「放心啦。又不是我第一次来医院！」
zh_CN: 「放心啦。又不是我第一次来医院！」
en: “Don't worry. It's not my first time in a hospital!”

source_zh_CN: 「……不过，确实是您第一次作为手术患者来医院。」
zh_CN: 「……不过，确实是您第一次作为手术患者来医院。」
en: “...It is your first time here as a surgical patient, though.”

source_zh_CN: 「啊哈哈，那倒是！所以才有意思嘛。」
zh_CN: 「啊哈哈，那倒是！所以才有意思嘛。」
en: “Ahaha, true! That's what makes it interesting.”

source_zh_CN: 【朝仓把入院用品交给瑞穗，带她进入病房。】
zh_CN: 【朝仓把入院用品交给瑞穗，带她进入病房。】
en: [Asakura hands Mizuho her admission supplies and takes her to the room.]

source_zh_CN: 「病房里先把东西放好。有什么不舒服，按呼叫铃就可以。」
zh_CN: 「病房里先把东西放好。有什么不舒服，按呼叫铃就可以。」
en: “Put your things away first. If anything feels wrong, use the call button.”

source_zh_CN: 「收到！不过今天我应该没什么需要呼叫的。」
zh_CN: 「收到！不过今天我应该没什么需要呼叫的。」
en: “Roger! I probably won't need to call for anything today, though.”
“I hope you say the same on Monday.”
“...Why did that sound a little scary?”

source_zh_CN: 【朝仓微微一笑，替她整理好床头的资料。】
zh_CN: 【朝仓微微一笑，替她整理好床头的资料。】
en: [Asakura smiles faintly and straightens the documents at her bedside.]

source_zh_CN: 「对啦，我现在可以去找千早吗？」
zh_CN: 「对啦，我现在可以去找千早吗？」
en: “Oh, can I go see Chihaya now?”

source_zh_CN: 「可以。她今天已经能下床活动了，不过不要让她太兴奋。」
zh_CN: 「可以。她今天已经能下床活动了，不过不要让她太兴奋。」
en: “Yes. She's able to get out of bed today, but don't get her too excited.”
“I'm visiting a patient, not going to war!”

source_zh_CN: 【千早的病房。千早穿着病服，扶着床边慢慢站起来，正准备去窗边活动。】
zh_CN: 【千早的病房。千早穿着病服，扶着床边慢慢站起来，正准备去窗边活动。】
en: [Chihaya's room. Wearing her patient pajamas, Chihaya slowly gets to her feet with a hand on the bed, preparing to walk over to the window.]
“Chihaya—!”
“Mizuho? You're here already?!”

source_zh_CN: 「我正式住院啦！以后我们就是同一层的病友了！」
zh_CN: 「我正式住院啦！以后我们就是同一层的病友了！」
en: “I'm officially admitted! We're fellow patients on the same floor now!”

source_zh_CN: 「……你为什么能把这种事说得像加入社团一样啊？」
zh_CN: 「……你为什么能把这种事说得像加入社团一样啊？」
en: “...Why do you make that sound like joining a club?”
“Aren't you happy? Now you've got company.”

source_zh_CN: 「我当然高兴……可是你下周一真的要开刀耶。」
zh_CN: 「我当然高兴……可是你下周一真的要开刀耶。」
en: “Of course I am... But you really are having surgery next Monday.”
“I know. I haven't forgotten the date.”
[Mizuho approaches the bed and looks Chihaya over.]
“Hey, you can stand up already!”
“Yeah. I still have to keep my movements small, though.”

source_zh_CN: 「恢复得不错嘛！那下周我们一起出院也没问题了。」
zh_CN: 「恢复得不错嘛！那下下周一我们一起出院也没问题了。」
en: “You're recovering nicely! Then we should be fine to leave together on the Monday after next.”

source_zh_CN: 「说起来……你怎么一点都不紧张？」
zh_CN: 「说起来……你怎么一点都不紧张？」
en: “Speaking of that... How are you not nervous at all?”

source_zh_CN: 「为什么要紧张？医生确认我身体好得很，手术也是我自己选的。」
zh_CN: 「为什么要紧张？医生确认我身体好得很，手术也是我自己选的。」
en: “Why would I be? The doctor confirmed I'm perfectly healthy, and I chose the surgery myself.”

source_zh_CN: 「就是因为你没开过刀，才不知道有多可怕啦！」
zh_CN: 「就是因为你没开过刀，才不知道有多可怕啦！」
en: “It's because you've never had surgery that you don't know how scary it is!”
“Here we go again.”

source_zh_CN: 「我跟你说真的！上手术台之前，护士围着你忙来忙去，什么都要检查。」
zh_CN: 「我跟你说真的！上手术台之前，护士围着你忙来忙去，什么都要检查。」
en: “I'm serious! Before you get on the table, nurses are bustling all around you, checking everything.”
“Isn't it good that the nurses are thorough?”

source_zh_CN: 「是好事！可是当她们说『下一步开始准备』的时候，你就会想知道到底还要准备什么！」
zh_CN: 「是好事！可是当她们说『下一步开始准备』的时候，你就会想知道到底还要准备什么！」
en: “It is! But when they say, ‘We'll start the next preparation,’ you wonder what else there is to prepare!”
“Then ask them.”

source_zh_CN: 「我问了！知道以后反而更害怕！」
zh_CN: 「我问了！知道以后反而更害怕！」
en: “I did! Finding out made it even scarier!”
“Hahahaha!”

source_zh_CN: 「不要笑！还有手术灯，器械，那个一看就知道真的要用的手术刀……」
zh_CN: 「不要笑！还有手术灯，器械，那个一看就知道真的要用的手术刀……」
en: “Don't laugh! And there's the surgical light, the instruments, that scalpel you can tell they're really going to use...”

source_zh_CN: 「千早，你已经把这个故事讲得像恐怖片了。」
zh_CN: 「千早，你已经把这个故事讲得像恐怖片了。」
en: “Chihaya, you're making this sound like a horror movie.”

source_zh_CN: 「你躺上去就知道是不是恐怖片！」
zh_CN: 「你躺上去就知道是不是恐怖片！」
en: “Lie down there yourself and see if it isn't!”

source_zh_CN: 「我可不一样。我是自愿去的，没理由逃跑。」
zh_CN: 「我可不一样。我是自愿去的，没理由逃跑。」
en: “I'm different. I'm going willingly, so there's no reason to run away.”
“...Was that about me?”
“Did I mention any names?”
“It's written all over your face!!”

source_zh_CN: 【两人互相瞪了一眼，瑞穗先笑了。千早也忍不住笑，随后轻轻按住腹部。】
zh_CN: 【两人互相瞪了一眼，瑞穗先笑了。千早也忍不住笑，随后轻轻按住腹部。】
en: [They glare at each other. Mizuho laughs first. Chihaya can't help laughing too, then gently presses a hand to her abdomen.]
“Hey, watch your incision.”
“I know. It's your fault for making me laugh.”

source_zh_CN: 「那我周一努力不笑你。你总该满意了吧？」
zh_CN: 「那我周一努力不笑你。你总该满意了吧？」
en: “Then I'll try not to laugh at you on Monday. Happy now?”
“...Mizuho.”
“Hmm?”
“Let me stay with you on Monday.”

source_zh_CN: 「从进手术室开始。我想一直陪着你。」
zh_CN: 「从进手术室开始。我想一直陪着你。」
en: “From when you go into the operating room. I want to stay with you the whole time.”
“You're still recovering yourself.”

source_zh_CN: 「我知道，我不会乱跑的。应该可以坐在旁边吧？」
zh_CN: 「我知道，我不会乱跑的。应该可以坐在旁边吧？」
en: “I know. I won't run around. I should be able to sit beside you, right?”
“...Are you coming to watch me embarrass myself?”
“No!”

source_zh_CN: 【千早抓住瑞穗的手，语气认真起来。】
zh_CN: 【千早抓住瑞穗的手，语气认真起来。】
en: [Chihaya takes Mizuho's hand, her tone turning earnest.]

source_zh_CN: 「上次是你陪我走到手术室门口。这次换我，好不好？」
zh_CN: 「上次是你陪我走到手术室门口。这次换我，好不好？」
en: “Last time you came with me to the operating room door. Let it be my turn, okay?”
“Sure. Then watch closely.”
“Watch what?”

source_zh_CN: 「看看什么叫真正勇敢的手术患者！」
zh_CN: 「看看什么叫真正勇敢的手术患者！」
en: “What a truly brave surgical patient looks like!”

source_zh_CN: 「等手术结束，你可得承认我比你强。」
zh_CN: 「等手术结束，你可得承认我比你强。」
en: “When it's over, you'll have to admit I'm tougher than you.”
“Let's wait until you're actually on the table!”

source_zh_CN: 【稍后，医院走廊。坂口从病房外经过，千早叫住他。】
zh_CN: 【稍后，医院走廊。坂口从病房外经过，千早叫住他。】
en: [Later, in a hospital corridor. As Sakaguchi passes outside the room, Chihaya calls out to him.]
“Dr. Sakaguchi!”

source_zh_CN: 「仓本小姐？怎么自己跑出来了？」
zh_CN: 「仓本小姐？怎么自己跑出来了？」
en: “Miss Kuramoto? Why have you run out here on your own?”
“I didn't run! I walked properly!”
“...All right. How is walking going today?”

source_zh_CN: 「还不错！所以我有件事想求你。」
zh_CN: 「还不错！所以我有件事想求你。」
en: “Pretty well! So there's something I want to ask you.”
“Go ahead.”

source_zh_CN: 「瑞穗周一开刀，我能进手术室陪她吗？」
zh_CN: 「瑞穗周一开刀，我能进手术室陪她吗？」
en: “Can I go into the operating room and stay with Mizuho during her surgery on Monday?”
“You want to go into the operating room?”
“Yeah. Just stand beside her and talk to her.”

source_zh_CN: 「你刚做完手术，还不能太勉强。」
zh_CN: 「你刚做完手术，还不能太勉强。」
en: “You've only just had surgery. You mustn't push yourself.”
“I'll behave! Sitting is fine too!”

source_zh_CN: 「而且你不能进入无菌区。那里不是给探病的人站的地方。」
zh_CN: 「而且你不能进入无菌区。那里不是给探病的人站的地方。」
en: “And you can't enter the sterile area. That isn't somewhere visitors can stand.”

source_zh_CN: 「我知道。我不碰器械，也不去医生们工作的地方。」
zh_CN: 「我知道。我不碰器械，也不去医生们工作的地方。」
en: “I know. I won't touch the instruments or go where the doctors work.”

source_zh_CN: 「还得换刷手服，戴手术帽和口罩。」
zh_CN: 「还得换刷手服，戴手术帽和口罩。」
en: “You'll also need scrubs, a surgical cap, and a mask.”
“...I have to wear scrubs too?”

source_zh_CN: 「是。头发要遮好。有人安排你待的位置，就待在那里。」
zh_CN: 「是。头发要遮好。有人安排你待的位置，就待在那里。」
en: “Yes. Cover your hair properly. Stay wherever you're assigned to sit.”
“Like an operating room nurse?!”

source_zh_CN: 「像观察者。你可没有护士资格。」
zh_CN: 「像观察者。你可没有护士资格。」
en: “Like an observer. You're not a qualified nurse.”
“Ahaha! I know!”

source_zh_CN: 「累了就坐下休息，必要时提前回病房。」
zh_CN: 「累了就坐下休息，必要时提前回病房。」
en: “Sit and rest when you're tired, and return to your room early if necessary.”
“...So you'll let me?”

source_zh_CN: 「瑞穗本人也愿意让你陪着，遵守这些条件就可以。」
zh_CN: 「瑞穗本人也愿意让你陪着，遵守这些条件就可以。」
en: “If Mizuho wants you there too, and you follow those conditions, yes.”
“She's already said yes!”
“Then all right. I'll ask a nurse to help you change.”
“Great! Thank you, Doctor!”

source_zh_CN: 【千早露出笑容，又突然想起什么。】
zh_CN: 【千早露出笑容，又突然想起什么。】
en: [Chihaya smiles, then suddenly remembers something.]

source_zh_CN: 「那个……我这次不会又被你们安排到手术台上吧？」
zh_CN: 「那个……我这次不会又被你们安排到手术台上吧？」
en: “Um... You won't put me on the operating table again this time, will you?”
“Mizuho is Monday's patient.”

source_zh_CN: 「我知道！可是听见『进手术室』还是会怕嘛。」
zh_CN: 「我知道！可是听见『进手术室』还是会怕嘛。」
en: “I know! But hearing ‘operating room’ still scares me.”
“This time you're going to keep someone company.”
“...Yeah. This time it's my turn to be there for her.”

source_zh_CN: 【医院工作区。坂口找到正在整理病例的阿库娅。】
zh_CN: 【医院工作区。坂口找到正在整理病例的阿库娅。】
en: [The hospital work area. Sakaguchi finds Aqua sorting through case notes.]
“Dr. Mizuki, are you free next Monday?”
“I am! Why? Another operation?”

source_zh_CN: 「支手瑞穗的开放腹部探查。我主刀，想请你做第一助手。」
zh_CN: 「支手瑞穗的开放腹部探查。我主刀，想请你做第一助手。」
en: “Mizuho Shite's open abdominal exploration. I'm operating, and I'd like you as first assistant.”
“Oh—the girl paying for her own laparotomy!”
“That's her.”
“What illness did you find, then?”
“None. Her preoperative tests are entirely normal.”

source_zh_CN: 「按已确认的范围做健康腹腔和盆腔的探查。」
zh_CN: 「按已确认的范围做健康腹腔和盆腔的探查。」
en: “We'll explore the healthy abdominal and pelvic cavities within the agreed scope.”

source_zh_CN: 「没有囊肿？没有要切掉的东西？连妇科病灶也没有？」
zh_CN: 「没有囊肿？没有要切掉的东西？连妇科病灶也没有？」
en: “No cysts? Nothing to remove? Not even a gynecological lesion?”
“There's currently no evidence of any abnormality.”

source_zh_CN: 「唔……那不就是打开、看一圈、再缝回去嘛。」
zh_CN: 「唔……那不就是打开、看一圈、再缝回去嘛。」
en: “Hmm... So it's just opening her up, taking a look around, and sewing her back up.”
“It isn't ‘just that’ for the patient.”

source_zh_CN: 「我知道啦！只是这回好像没什么挑战性。」
zh_CN: 「我知道啦！只是这回好像没什么挑战性。」
en: “I know! It just doesn't sound very challenging this time.”
“So you're declining?”

source_zh_CN: 「你找别人吧！我还有病例想研究呢。」
zh_CN: 「你找别人吧！我还有病例想研究呢。」
en: “Ask someone else! I have cases I want to study.”
“...All right.”

source_zh_CN: 【稍后，影像诊断科。芹香正在整理当天的资料。】
zh_CN: 【稍后，影像诊断科。芹香正在整理当天的资料。】
en: [Later, in Diagnostic Imaging. Serika is sorting the day's documents.]
“Dr. Misono, may I interrupt?”
“What is it?”

source_zh_CN: 「下周一有台择期开腹。我想请你当助手。」
zh_CN: 「下周一有台择期开腹。我想请你当助手。」
en: “I have an elective laparotomy next Monday. I'd like you to assist.”
“...The patient?”

source_zh_CN: 「支手瑞穗，十八岁。所有术前检查都正常。」
zh_CN: 「支手瑞穗，十八岁。所有术前检查都正常。」
en: “Mizuho Shite, eighteen. All preoperative tests are normal.”
“Then what's the purpose of the laparotomy?”

source_zh_CN: 「她自愿申请健康探查。院方和我都已经确认接受。」
zh_CN: 「她自愿申请健康探查。院方和我都已经确认接受。」
en: “She requested an exploration while healthy. The hospital and I have agreed to accept her.”
[Serika stops writing.]
“...What does she think surgery is?”
“I knew you'd say that.”
“Does she understand what she's going to undergo?”

source_zh_CN: 「说明过了，也签了同意书。她还选了不麻醉。」
zh_CN: 「说明过了，也签了同意书。她还选了不麻醉。」
en: “We've explained it, and she's signed consent. She's also chosen no anesthesia.”
“Quite an extraordinary patient.”

source_zh_CN: 「你可以拒绝。我只是来问你愿不愿意协助。」
zh_CN: 「你可以拒绝。我只是来问你愿不愿意协助。」
en: “You can refuse. I'm only asking if you're willing to assist.”

source_zh_CN: 【芹香看了他片刻，打开瑞穗的检查资料。】
zh_CN: 【芹香看了他片刻，打开瑞穗的检查资料。】
en: [Serika watches him for a moment, then opens Mizuho's test results.]

source_zh_CN: 「既然已经决定做，就不能因为她健康而减少准备。」
zh_CN: 「既然已经决定做，就不能因为她健康而减少准备。」
en: “If the decision is made, her being healthy is no reason to reduce the preparation.”
“Of course.”

source_zh_CN: 「腹部体表定位、器械和暴露范围，我要提前确认。」
zh_CN: 「腹部体表定位、器械和暴露范围，我要提前确认。」
en: “I want to confirm the abdominal surface landmarks, instruments, and extent of exposure beforehand.”
“No problem. I'll take responsibility for the final operative plan.”
“...I know.”
[Serika closes the file.]
“I'll assist.”

source_zh_CN: 「谢谢。弘子负责器械，米田护士巡回。」
zh_CN: 「谢谢。弘子负责器械，米田护士巡回。」
en: “Thank you. Hiroko will handle instruments, and Nurse Yoneda will circulate.”
“I'll check everything with them.”

source_zh_CN: 【上午稍后，瑞穗的病房。坂口带着芹香、杉村弘子和米田栞来到床边。朝仓也在场。】
zh_CN: 【上午稍后，瑞穗的病房。坂口带着芹香、杉村弘子和米田栞来到床边。朝仓也在场。】
en: [Later that morning, in Mizuho's room. Sakaguchi brings Serika, Hiroko Sugimura, and Shiori Yoneda to her bedside. Asakura is there too.]
“Wow! So many people?”

source_zh_CN: 「来和你确认周一的安排。这几位是手术团队。」
zh_CN: 「来和你确认周一的安排。这几位是手术团队。」
en: “We're here to confirm Monday's arrangements. This is your surgical team.”
“So formal!”
“Dr. Misono will be first assistant.”
“Serika Misono. Pleased to meet you.”
“Oh! Chihaya told me about you!”
“...Did she?”

source_zh_CN: 「她说你特别厉害，还会讲女子高中的趣事！」
zh_CN: 「她说你特别厉害，还会讲女子高中的趣事！」
en: “She said you're amazing, and you tell funny stories about girls' high school!”
“...Let's discuss the surgery first.”
“Oh, okay.”
“Nurse Hiroko Sugimura will handle instruments.”

source_zh_CN: 「你好呀，支手小姐。手术台上医生需要什么，我会负责准备。」
zh_CN: 「你好呀，支手小姐。手术台上医生需要什么，我会负责准备。」
en: “Hello, Miss Shite. I'll prepare whatever the doctors need at the operating table.”
“Then I'm in good hands!”

source_zh_CN: 「嗯。不过你周一要听医生的话哦。」
zh_CN: 「嗯。不过你周一要听医生的话哦。」
en: “Yes. But you must listen to the doctors on Monday.”
“Nurse Shiori Yoneda will circulate.”

source_zh_CN: 「我会负责监护协助、术前准备和必要的记录。有什么不舒服，请直接告诉我。」
zh_CN: 「我会负责监护协助、术前准备和必要的记录。有什么不舒服，请直接告诉我。」
en: “I'll assist with monitoring, preoperative preparation, and the necessary records. Please tell me directly if anything feels wrong.”

source_zh_CN: 「好！我会尽量不给大家添麻烦。」
zh_CN: 「好！我会尽量不给大家添麻烦。」
en: “Okay! I'll try not to cause any trouble.”

source_zh_CN: 「病房准备由我负责。我们周一早晨会提前开始。」
zh_CN: 「病房准备由我负责。我们周一早晨会提前开始。」
en: “I'll handle the ward preparations. We'll start early on Monday morning.”
“Okay, okay!”
“Miss Shite.”
“Yes!”

source_zh_CN: 「最后确认一次。手术不是做完体检就结束了。术前准备、切开、探查、关腹，都要由你本人经历。」
zh_CN: 「最后确认一次。手术不是做完体检就结束了。术前准备、切开、探查、关腹，都要由你本人经历。」
en: “One final confirmation. Surgery doesn't end with the examination. You personally will undergo preparation, incision, exploration, and closure.”

source_zh_CN: 「我知道呀。所以我才特地来了。」
zh_CN: 「我知道呀。所以我才特地来了。」
en: “I know. That's why I came here.”
“You're still choosing no anesthesia?”
“I am! I'm serious about this!”
“...Understood.”
[Serika makes a note in the record.]
“Hehe, full of energy, aren't you?”

source_zh_CN: 「周一需要配合的时候，我会一步一步告诉您。」
zh_CN: 「周一需要配合的时候，我会一步一步告诉您。」
en: “On Monday, I'll tell you step by step when we need your cooperation.”
“I'm counting on all of you!”

source_zh_CN: 【团队准备离开。瑞穗突然叫住坂口。】
zh_CN: 【团队准备离开。瑞穗突然叫住坂口。】
en: [The team prepares to leave. Mizuho suddenly calls Sakaguchi back.]
“Dr. Sakaguchi.”
“Yes?”

source_zh_CN: 「你可要把我缝得漂亮一点哦。我以后还要穿泳衣的！」
zh_CN: 「你可要把我缝得漂亮一点哦。我以后还要穿泳衣的！」
en: “Make sure you sew me up nicely. I still want to wear swimsuits!”

source_zh_CN: 「伤口会按计划认真关闭。恢复和疤痕护理也要你配合。」
zh_CN: 「伤口会按计划认真关闭。恢复和疤痕护理也要你配合。」
en: “We'll close the wound carefully as planned. You'll need to cooperate with recovery and scar care too.”
“Hehe, it's a deal!”

source_zh_CN: 【芹香向坂口点头，几人离开病房。瑞穗仍笑眯眯地看着门口。】
zh_CN: 【芹香向坂口点头，几人离开病房。瑞穗仍笑眯眯地看着门口。】
en: [Serika nods to Sakaguchi, and they leave. Mizuho is still smiling toward the doorway.]

source_zh_CN: 【周六傍晚。坂口处理完当天工作，经过住院楼，顺道来到瑞穗的病房。】
zh_CN: 【周六傍晚。坂口处理完当天工作，经过住院楼，顺道来到瑞穗的病房。】
en: [Saturday evening. Having finished his work, Sakaguchi passes through the inpatient building and stops by Mizuho's room.]
“Miss Shite, still awake?”
“Doctor! What brings you here?”

source_zh_CN: 「想看看你术前状态怎么样。再过两天就到周一了。」
zh_CN: 「想看看你术前状态怎么样。再过两天就到周一了。」
en: “I wanted to see how you're doing before surgery. Monday's only two days away.”

source_zh_CN: 「我知道啦。我又不是连星期几都记不住。」
zh_CN: 「我知道啦。我又不是连星期几都记不住。」
en: “I know. I can remember what day it is.”
“Nervous?”
“No!”
“That was quick.”

source_zh_CN: 「因为答案本来就这样呀。既然决定开刀，我就做好心理准备了。」
zh_CN: 「因为答案本来就这样呀。既然决定开刀，我就做好心理准备了。」
en: “Because that's the answer. Once I decided on surgery, I prepared myself mentally.”

source_zh_CN: 「嗯。哪怕是你主动申请的手术，也可以告诉我自己害怕。」
zh_CN: 「嗯。哪怕是你主动申请的手术，也可以告诉我自己害怕。」
en: “Mm. Even if you requested it yourself, you can still tell me you're scared.”
“Aren't you underestimating me, Doctor?”
“Not at all.”

source_zh_CN: 「而且我想好了。周一我要表现得比千早勇敢，省下来的麻醉费还能做别的事。」
zh_CN: 「而且我想好了。周一我要表现得比千早勇敢，省下来的麻醉费还能做别的事。」
en: “And I've decided. On Monday I'll be braver than Chihaya, and I can use the money saved on anesthesia for other things.”
“...So you are still thinking about that anesthesia fee.”
“Of course! I don't like wasting money.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗向床边挪了挪，笑得有些狡黠。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗向床边挪了挪，笑得有些狡黠。】
en: [Mizuho moves toward the edge of the bed, smiling slyly.]
“By the way, Doctor. Are you busy tonight?”
“I'm finished with work. Why?”
“Then... Would you keep me company a little longer?”
“Is something bothering you?”
“Not that kind of company.”

source_zh_CN: 【她把声音放低，直截了当地发出成年人的亲密邀请。】
zh_CN: 【她把声音放低，直截了当地发出成年人的亲密邀请。】
en: [She lowers her voice and makes a direct invitation to adult intimacy.]

source_zh_CN: 「就是，留下来和我做点大人之间的事情嘛。」
zh_CN: 「就是，留下来和我做点大人之间的事情嘛。」
en: “I mean, stay and do something grown-up with me.”
“...What are you talking about?”
“Wasn't I clear enough?”
“You're my patient.”

source_zh_CN: 「可是你又不是不喜欢我。至少不讨厌吧？」
zh_CN: 「可是你又不是不喜欢我。至少不讨厌吧？」
en: “But it's not like you don't like me. You don't dislike me, at least?”
“That's a different matter.”

source_zh_CN: 「真严格呀。以前玩的游戏里，医生和患者之间不是经常这样吗？」
zh_CN: 「真严格呀。以前玩的游戏里，医生和患者之间不是经常这样吗？」
en: “So strict. In games I've played, doctors and patients do this all the time, don't they?”
“You're comparing games to reality?”
“Like In'nai Kansen, for example.”
“That's a game!”
[Having said that, Sakaguchi suddenly stops.]
“...Wait. Which game did you just say?”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗眨了眨眼，露出一个坏笑。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗眨了眨眼，露出一个坏笑。】
en: [Mizuho blinks and gives him a mischievous grin.]
“Hehehe. Just pretend you didn't hear that.”
“You little...”

source_zh_CN: 「好嘛，我知道了。今天不为难你。」
zh_CN: 「好嘛，我知道了。今天不为难你。」
en: “All right, I understand. I won't make things difficult for you today.”

source_zh_CN: 「今晚早点休息。周一的准备要从早上开始。」
zh_CN: 「今晚早点休息。周一的准备要从早上开始。」
en: “Get some rest early tonight. Monday's preparations start in the morning.”
“Okaaay—I'll sleep like a baby.”
[Sakaguchi reaches the door.]
“Doctor!”
“What now?”

source_zh_CN: 「周一就拜托你啦。一定要好好照顾我哦！」
zh_CN: 「周一就拜托你啦。一定要好好照顾我哦！」
en: “I'm counting on you on Monday. Take good care of me!”
“I will.”
“Then I'm not worried. Good night!”

source_zh_CN: 【坂口离开。瑞穗伸个懒腰，心情愉快地躺回床上。】
zh_CN: 【坂口离开。瑞穗伸个懒腰，心情愉快地躺回床上。】
en: [Sakaguchi leaves. Mizuho stretches and happily settles back into bed.]

source_zh_CN: 【周一早晨。瑞穗的病房。术前准备已经持续了一阵，朝仓正在整理准备记录。瑞穗趴在床上，脸埋进枕头，一动也不想动。】
zh_CN: 【周一早晨。瑞穗的病房。术前准备已经持续了一阵，朝仓正在整理准备记录。瑞穗趴在床上，脸埋进枕头，一动也不想动。】
en: [Monday morning, in Mizuho's room. Preoperative preparations have been underway for a while. Asakura organizes the preparation records. Mizuho lies face down, her face buried in a pillow, unwilling to move at all.]

source_zh_CN: 「支手小姐，准备得差不多了。还好吗？」
zh_CN: 「支手小姐，准备得差不多了。还好吗？」
en: “Miss Shite, we're nearly done with preparation. Are you all right?”
“...Not really.”
“What's bothering you?”
“Everything.”

source_zh_CN: 【朝仓看了看记录，又看向床上的瑞穗。】
zh_CN: 【朝仓看了看记录，又看向床上的瑞穗。】
en: [Asakura looks at the record, then back at Mizuho on the bed.]

source_zh_CN: 「早晨的备皮和灌肠已经完成了，接下来会安排转运。」
zh_CN: 「早晨的备皮和灌肠已经完成了，接下来会安排转运。」
en: “This morning's shaving and enema are finished. We'll arrange transport next.”

source_zh_CN: 「为什么你能这么平静地说出这两个词啊……」
zh_CN: 「为什么你能这么平静地说出这两个词啊……」
en: “How can you say those two words so calmly...?”

source_zh_CN: 「因为这两项工作已经完成了呀。」
zh_CN: 「因为这两项工作已经完成了呀。」
en: “Because both tasks are finished.”

source_zh_CN: 「完成得太彻底了……我现在只想趴着。」
zh_CN: 「完成得太彻底了……我现在只想趴着。」
en: “Far too thoroughly... All I want to do now is lie here.”

source_zh_CN: 【千早坐在病床旁边，努力忍着笑。】
zh_CN: 【千早坐在病床旁边，努力忍着笑。】
en: [Chihaya sits beside the bed, trying hard not to laugh.]
“Didn't I warn you?”
“...Don't say anything.”

source_zh_CN: 「你前几天还说术前准备肯定没问题。」
zh_CN: 「你前几天还说术前准备肯定没问题。」
en: “A few days ago you were saying the preparation would be no problem.”
“Now I know!”
“There's still the catheter.”
“...What?”

source_zh_CN: 「导尿会在手术室里由米田护士负责。」
zh_CN: 「导尿会在手术室里由米田护士负责。」
en: “Nurse Yoneda will place the catheter in the operating room.”
“There's more?!”

source_zh_CN: 「所以我才说，你还没到最可怕的部分！」
zh_CN: 「所以我才说，你还没到最可怕的部分！」
en: “That's why I said you haven't reached the scariest part yet!”
“You look awfully happy right now!”
“I'm concerned about you!”
“You're obviously trying not to laugh!”

source_zh_CN: 「因为你之前还说自己一定比我勇敢呀！」
zh_CN: 「因为你之前还说自己一定比我勇敢呀！」
en: “Because you said you'd definitely be braver than me!”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗把脸从枕头里抬起一点。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗把脸从枕头里抬起一点。】
en: [Mizuho lifts her face slightly from the pillow.]

source_zh_CN: 「……反正我还没开刀。正式手术时，我会好好配合的。」
zh_CN: 「……反正我还没开刀。正式手术时，我会好好配合的。」
en: “...Anyway, they haven't operated yet. I'll cooperate properly during the actual surgery.”

source_zh_CN: 「那就请您先坐起来。等会儿上担架车需要帮忙。」
zh_CN: 「那就请您先坐起来。等会儿上担架车需要帮忙。」
en: “Then please sit up first. You'll need help getting onto the stretcher.”
“...Can I stay like this for one more minute?”
“One minute.”
“Hahaha!”

source_zh_CN: 【病房门被轻轻敲响。岩崎留美推着担架车进来，身上仍穿着普通护士制服。】
zh_CN: 【病房门被轻轻敲响。岩崎留美推着担架车进来，身上仍穿着普通护士制服。】
en: [There is a soft knock. Rumi Iwasaki wheels in a stretcher, still in her ordinary nursing uniform.]

source_zh_CN: 「早上好！支手瑞穗小姐，手术室来接人啦！」
zh_CN: 「早上好！支手瑞穗小姐，手术室来接人啦！」
en: “Good morning! Miss Mizuho Shite, your ride to the operating room is here!”
“...You're here already?!”

source_zh_CN: 「预约就是今天呀。咦，你怎么趴着不动？」
zh_CN: 「预约就是今天呀。咦，你怎么趴着不动？」
en: “Your appointment is today. Huh, why are you lying there so still?”

source_zh_CN: 「她刚做完术前准备，已经快没力气了。」
zh_CN: 「她刚做完术前准备，已经快没力气了。」
en: “She just finished her preparations, and she's already exhausted.”

source_zh_CN: 「哎呀。前几天还听说有位小姐特别勇敢，连麻醉都省了呢。」
zh_CN: 「哎呀。前几天还听说有位小姐特别勇敢，连麻醉都省了呢。」
en: “Oh dear. A few days ago I heard about a very brave young lady who was even skipping anesthesia.”
“...That's me.”

source_zh_CN: 「真的是你呀？看来勇敢也要耗体力的嘛！」
zh_CN: 「真的是你呀？看来勇敢也要耗体力的嘛！」
en: “So it really is you! Looks like being brave takes energy too!”
“Please don't laugh at me, Nurse...”

source_zh_CN: 【留美和朝仓扶瑞穗坐起来，帮她整理好遮盖，准备转到担架车上。】
zh_CN: 【留美和朝仓扶瑞穗坐起来，帮她整理好遮盖，准备转到担架车上。】
en: [Rumi and Asakura help Mizuho sit up, adjust her covering, and prepare to transfer her to the stretcher.]

source_zh_CN: 「支手小姐，接下来动作慢一点。」
zh_CN: 「支手小姐，接下来动作慢一点。」
en: “Move slowly now, Miss Shite.”
“Okay...”

source_zh_CN: 「千早小姐，你也要一起过去对吧？」
zh_CN: 「千早小姐，你也要一起过去对吧？」
en: “Miss Chihaya, you're coming along too, right?”

source_zh_CN: 「嗯！坂口医生答应让我进去陪她。」
zh_CN: 「嗯！坂口医生答应让我进去陪她。」
en: “Yes! Dr. Sakaguchi said I could go in and stay with her.”

source_zh_CN: 「我知道，之后还要带你去更衣。」
zh_CN: 「我知道，之后还要带你去更衣。」
en: “I know. I'll take you to get changed afterward.”

source_zh_CN: 「好嘛。千早，你就等着看我好好表现。」
zh_CN: 「好嘛。千早，你就等着看我好好表现。」
en: “Fine. Chihaya, just watch how well I do.”
“Sit properly first!”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗在两名护士协助下躺好。留美推起担架车，千早跟在旁边，一起离开病房。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗在两名护士协助下躺好。留美推起担架车，千早跟在旁边，一起离开病房。】
en: [With both nurses' help, Mizuho lies down. Rumi pushes the stretcher out of the room, with Chihaya walking alongside.]

source_zh_CN: 【手术室。瑞穗戴好遮住头发的患者帽，被转到手术台上。米田开始接监护设备；弘子正在核对稍后要用的器械。】
zh_CN: 【手术室。瑞穗戴好遮住头发的患者帽，被转到手术台上。米田开始接监护设备；弘子正在核对稍后要用的器械。】
en: [The operating room. With her hair covered by a patient cap, Mizuho is transferred onto the operating table. Yoneda connects the monitors while Hiroko checks the instruments they will need later.]

source_zh_CN: 「支手小姐，我是米田。上周五在病房见过面，今天由我负责巡回。」
zh_CN: 「支手小姐，我是米田。上周五在病房见过面，今天由我负责巡回。」
en: “Miss Shite, I'm Yoneda. We met in your room last Friday. I'll be your circulating nurse today.”
“I remember... Nurse Yoneda.”

source_zh_CN: 「先测血压、心率。手臂放在这里，肩膀放松一点。」
zh_CN: 「先测血压、心率。手臂放在这里，肩膀放松一点。」
en: “Blood pressure and heart rate first. Put your arm here and relax your shoulders a little.”
“...Okay.”

source_zh_CN: 【坂口穿着刷手服来到台边，尚未穿无菌手术袍。】
zh_CN: 【坂口穿着刷手服来到台边，尚未穿无菌手术袍。】
en: [Sakaguchi comes to the table in scrubs, not yet wearing a sterile gown.]
“Good morning, Mizuho.”
“Dr. Sakaguchi! You're here!”

source_zh_CN: 「现在再确认一次。今天按约定进行健康腹腔和盆腔的开放探查。不麻醉的选择，还是你的意思吗？」
zh_CN: 「现在再确认一次。今天按约定进行健康腹腔和盆腔的开放探查。不麻醉的选择，还是你的意思吗？」
en: “Let's confirm once more. Today we'll perform the agreed open exploration of your healthy abdominal and pelvic cavities. Is no anesthesia still your choice?”
“Of course! I'm already up here!”

source_zh_CN: 「嗯。过程中哪里不舒服，要直接说。」
zh_CN: 「嗯。过程中哪里不舒服，要直接说。」
en: “All right. Tell us directly if anything feels wrong.”

source_zh_CN: 「我知道。我已经做好心理准备了！」
zh_CN: 「我知道。我已经做好心理准备了！」
en: “I know. I'm mentally prepared!”

source_zh_CN: 【米田协助瑞穗调整身体位置，护士们重新整理遮盖。瑞穗抬眼看见正上方的手术灯。】
zh_CN: 【米田协助瑞穗调整身体位置，护士们重新整理遮盖。瑞穗抬眼看见正上方的手术灯。】
en: [Yoneda helps position Mizuho, and the nurses adjust her covering. Mizuho looks up at the surgical light directly overhead.]

source_zh_CN: 「哇……原来躺在这里看是这样的呀。」
zh_CN: 「哇……原来躺在这里看是这样的呀。」
en: “Wow... So this is what it looks like lying here.”
“How do you feel?”
“A little strange. But I'm fine!”

source_zh_CN: 【坂口做最后的常规体表检查，注意到她平日锻炼形成的匀称线条。】
zh_CN: 【坂口做最后的常规体表检查，注意到她平日锻炼形成的匀称线条。】
en: [Sakaguchi performs a final routine external examination, noticing the balanced muscle tone from her regular exercise.]

source_zh_CN: 「身体条件很好。平时运动不少吧？」
zh_CN: 「身体条件很好。平时运动不少吧？」
en: “You're in very good shape. You exercise a lot?”

source_zh_CN: 「嘿嘿！看得出来？我很注意身材的！」
zh_CN: 「嘿嘿！看得出来？我很注意身材的！」
en: “Hehe! You can tell? I take good care of my figure!”
“Your abdominal muscles are in good condition too.”

source_zh_CN: 「那当然！我可比千早更成熟一点哦！」
zh_CN: 「那当然！我可比千早更成熟一点哦！」
en: “Of course! I'm a little more mature than Chihaya!”

source_zh_CN: 【弘子尚未进入无菌器械岗位，帮忙确认准备情况时看见瑞穗格外鲜明的肤色反差。她的手臂和身体外侧晒成小麦色，原本被连体泳衣遮住的胸腹部则是一大片白皙的肤色。】
zh_CN: 【弘子尚未进入无菌器械岗位，帮忙确认准备情况时看见瑞穗格外鲜明的肤色反差。她的手臂和身体外侧晒成小麦色，原本被连体泳衣遮住的胸腹部则是一大片白皙的肤色。】
en: [Hiroko, not yet at her sterile instrument station, notices Mizuho's striking contrast in skin tones while helping check the preparations. Her arms and outer body are tanned, while the chest and abdomen normally covered by her one-piece swimsuit form a broad area of pale skin.]
“Oh my, what pretty tan lines.”
“Huh?”

source_zh_CN: 「这是连体泳衣留下的吧？深浅分得真整齐。」
zh_CN: 「这是连体泳衣留下的吧？深浅分得真整齐。」
en: “A one-piece swimsuit, right? The contrast is so neat.”

source_zh_CN: 「被看出来啦！以前常常在外面晒太阳。」
zh_CN: 「被看出来啦！以前常常在外面晒太阳。」
en: “You caught me! I used to sunbathe outdoors a lot.”

source_zh_CN: 「确实很醒目。手术灯一照，对比更明显了。」
zh_CN: 「确实很醒目。手术灯一照，对比更明显了。」
en: “They certainly stand out. Even more under the surgical light.”
“Right? I like them myself!”

source_zh_CN: 「而且身材也很好看。说真的，还挺性感的呢。」
zh_CN: 「而且身材也很好看。说真的，还挺性感的呢。」
en: “And you have a lovely figure. Honestly, quite sexy.”
“Hehehe! You've got a good eye, Hiroko!”

source_zh_CN: 【她得意地挺了挺肩膀，随即看见手术台旁边正在准备的器械，笑容忽然停了一下。】
zh_CN: 【她得意地挺了挺肩膀，随即看见手术台旁边正在准备的器械，笑容忽然停了一下。】
en: [She proudly straightens her shoulders, then notices the instruments being prepared beside the table. Her smile suddenly falters.]
“...Wait a second.”
“What is it?”
“You're complimenting me, right?”
“Of course.”

source_zh_CN: 「可是……我现在是躺在手术台上耶。」
zh_CN: 「可是……我现在是躺在手术台上耶。」
en: “But... I'm lying on an operating table right now.”
“Yes. Your surgery will start shortly.”

source_zh_CN: 「怎么回事……我是不是把这台手术弄得越来越像什么奇怪的 play 了……？」
zh_CN: 「怎么回事……我是不是把这台手术弄得越来越像什么奇怪的 play 了……？」
en: “What's going on... Am I making this surgery seem more and more like some strange kind of play...?”

source_zh_CN: 【米田调整好她的手臂位置，继续核对监护。】
zh_CN: 【米田调整好她的手臂位置，继续核对监护。】
en: [Yoneda adjusts her arm position and continues checking the monitors.]

source_zh_CN: 「固定的位置还舒适吗？肩膀有没有拉得太紧？」
zh_CN: 「固定的位置还舒适吗？肩膀有没有拉得太紧？」
en: “Are you comfortable in that position? Are your shoulders being pulled too tightly?”
“...I'm okay.”

source_zh_CN: 「刚才还那么得意，怎么突然没精神了？」
zh_CN: 「刚才还那么得意，怎么突然没精神了？」
en: “You were so pleased a moment ago. Why so quiet all of a sudden?”

source_zh_CN: 「我只是在想……你们好像真的要开始做准备了。」
zh_CN: 「我只是在想……你们好像真的要开始做准备了。」
en: “I was just thinking... You really seem to be starting the preparations.”

source_zh_CN: 「是呀。今天不是专门来做手术的吗？」
zh_CN: 「是呀。今天不是专门来做手术的吗？」
en: “Yes. Didn't you come here specifically for surgery today?”
“...That's true.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗往腹部的方向看了一眼，又抬头看手术灯。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗往腹部的方向看了一眼，又抬头看手术灯。】
en: [Mizuho glances toward her abdomen, then back up at the surgical light.]
“...Dr. Sakaguchi.”
“Yes?”
“You'll stay here the whole time, right?”
“I'm the surgeon. We'll begin when everything's ready.”
“That's good...”

source_zh_CN: 【芹香穿着刷手服走到台边。她核对过瑞穗的资料，尚未刷手穿无菌袍。】
zh_CN: 【芹香穿着刷手服走到台边。她核对过瑞穗的资料，尚未刷手穿无菌袍。】
en: [Serika approaches the table in scrubs. She has reviewed Mizuho's records but has not yet scrubbed in or put on a sterile gown.]

source_zh_CN: 「支手小姐，我再做一次腹部检查。请平躺。」
zh_CN: 「支手小姐，我再做一次腹部检查。请平躺。」
en: “Miss Shite, I'll examine your abdomen again. Please lie flat.”
“Oh, Dr. Misono!”

source_zh_CN: 「膝盖稍微放松。先看腹部的情况。」
zh_CN: 「膝盖稍微放松。先看腹部的情况。」
en: “Relax your knees a little. I'll check your abdomen first.”
“Okay!”

source_zh_CN: 【芹香戴好检查手套，触诊瑞穗的腹部。】
zh_CN: 【芹香戴好检查手套，触诊瑞穗的腹部。】
en: [Serika puts on examination gloves and palpates Mizuho's abdomen.]
“Any discomfort here?”
“N-no.”
“And here?”
“Um... A little pressure.”
“Good. Normal abdominal wall response.”

source_zh_CN: 【她继续按既定范围检查，瑞穗不自觉绷紧了肚子。】
zh_CN: 【她继续按既定范围检查，瑞穗不自觉绷紧了肚子。】
en: [She continues examining the planned area. Mizuho involuntarily tenses her stomach.]
“Relax.”
“I am relaxing.”
“Your abdomen is rigid.”
“Because your hands are so cold, Doctor...”
“Then I'll give you a moment to steady your breathing.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗呼了一口气，芹香再度检查，随后与坂口确认结果。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗呼了一口气，芹香再度检查，随后与坂口确认结果。】
en: [Mizuho exhales. Serika examines her again, then confirms the findings with Sakaguchi.]

source_zh_CN: 「体表检查与资料一致。预定探查范围不用调整。」
zh_CN: 「体表检查与资料一致。预定探查范围不用调整。」
en: “The external examination matches the records. No change to the planned exploration.”
“Mm. The incision remains as planned.”
“I'll mark it first.”
“...Mark what?”

source_zh_CN: 【芹香拿起标记笔，在与坂口确认的位置画出预定切口线。瑞穗看着那条线落在自己腹部，忽然不说话了。】
zh_CN: 【芹香拿起标记笔，在与坂口确认的位置画出预定切口线。瑞穗看着那条线落在自己腹部，忽然不说话了。】
en: [Serika picks up a marker and draws the planned incision line at the location agreed with Sakaguchi. Watching the line appear on her abdomen, Mizuho suddenly falls silent.]
“...Dr. Misono.”
“Yes?”
“This line... Is where you'll cut?”
“Yes. The surgeon has confirmed it.”
“...That long?”

source_zh_CN: 「需要足够的暴露才能完成检查。」
zh_CN: 「需要足够的暴露才能完成检查。」
en: “We need sufficient exposure to complete the examination.”

source_zh_CN: 【芹香转向弘子，逐项确认器械。】
zh_CN: 【芹香转向弘子，逐项确认器械。】
en: [Serika turns to Hiroko and confirms the instruments one by one.]

source_zh_CN: 「弘子护士，皮肤切开先备十号刀片。后续分离器械按清单准备。」
zh_CN: 「弘子护士，皮肤切开先备十号刀片。后续分离器械按清单准备。」
en: “Nurse Hiroko, prepare a number ten blade for the skin incision. Have the subsequent dissection instruments ready according to the list.”

source_zh_CN: 「明白。刀柄和刀片我会核对好。」
zh_CN: 「明白。刀柄和刀片我会核对好。」
en: “Understood. I'll check the handle and blade.”

source_zh_CN: 「牵开器的规格也再确认一下。」
zh_CN: 「牵开器的规格也再确认一下。」
en: “Confirm the retractor size again as well.”
“It's ready.”
“W-wait!”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗的膝盖不自觉动了一下。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗的膝盖不自觉动了一下。】
en: [Mizuho's knee moves involuntarily.]
“Miss Shite, please don't lift your leg suddenly.”
“B-but they're talking about blades!”
“We're confirming the instruments before surgery.”

source_zh_CN: 「我知道！可是你们说得太具体了啦！」
zh_CN: 「我知道！可是你们说得太具体了啦！」
en: “I know! But you're being so specific!”
“Being specific prevents mistakes.”
“...Chihaya said you were gentle!”
[Serika looks up at her briefly.]
“She cooperated well.”
“Are you all right?”

source_zh_CN: 「我、我当然还好……就是那条线看着……」
zh_CN: 「我、我当然还好……就是那条线看着……」
en: “O-of course I'm all right... It's just, looking at that line...”

source_zh_CN: 「害怕可以说。检查时不要突然动。」
zh_CN: 「害怕可以说。检查时不要突然动。」
en: “You can say you're scared. Don't move suddenly during the examination.”

source_zh_CN: 「那、那我可以先不看这条线吗？」
zh_CN: 「那、那我可以先不看这条线吗？」
en: “Th-then can I stop looking at the line for now?”
“Yes.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗立刻把视线移向手术灯。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗立刻把视线移向手术灯。】
en: [Mizuho immediately looks away toward the surgical light.]
“...Whew.”

source_zh_CN: 【切口标记完成。米田继续为瑞穗进行导尿及术前皮肤准备。】
zh_CN: 【切口标记完成。米田继续为瑞穗进行导尿及术前皮肤准备。】
en: [The incision marking is complete. Yoneda continues with catheterization and preoperative skin preparation.]

source_zh_CN: 「支手小姐，接下来要放置导尿管。先跟您说一声。」
zh_CN: 「支手小姐，接下来要放置导尿管。先跟您说一声。」
en: “Miss Shite, we'll place the urinary catheter next. I'm letting you know first.”
“...Oh, the thing Chihaya mentioned!”

source_zh_CN: 「是。已经在术前说明里确认过了。」
zh_CN: 「是。已经在术前说明里确认过了。」
en: “Yes. We confirmed this during your preoperative explanation.”

source_zh_CN: 「我记得……只是现在突然有点不想记得了。」
zh_CN: 「我记得……只是现在突然有点不想记得了。」
en: “I remember... I've just suddenly decided I'd rather not remember.”

source_zh_CN: 「会有些不适。我会告诉您什么时候开始。」
zh_CN: 「会有些不适。我会告诉您什么时候开始。」
en: “There will be some discomfort. I'll tell you when we're starting.”
“...Okay.”

source_zh_CN: 【米田按流程开始清醒状态下的导尿准备，调整遮盖，瑞穗紧张地抓住手边的床单。】
zh_CN: 【米田按流程开始清醒状态下的导尿准备，调整遮盖，瑞穗紧张地抓住手边的床单。】
en: [Yoneda begins the preparations for catheterization while Mizuho is awake, adjusting the covering. Mizuho nervously clutches the sheet beside her.]
“W-wait, have you started already?”
“We're about to. Please relax as much as you can.”
“I'm trying really hard!”

source_zh_CN: 【导尿过程中，瑞穗猛地吸了一口气，脸一下红了。】
zh_CN: 【导尿过程中，瑞穗猛地吸了一口气，脸一下红了。】
en: [During catheterization, Mizuho draws a sharp breath, her face flushing at once.]

source_zh_CN: 「呜哇——！这个、这个感觉也太奇怪了吧！」
zh_CN: 「呜哇——！这个、这个感觉也太奇怪了吧！」
en: “Waaah—! Th-that feels so strange!”
“Don't lift your hips. We're almost finished.”

source_zh_CN: 「说是快完成，可我怎么觉得好久啊！」
zh_CN: 「说是快完成，可我怎么觉得好久啊！」
en: “You say almost, but why does it feel so long?!”

source_zh_CN: 「已经放置好了。接下来固定导管，确认引流。」
zh_CN: 「已经放置好了。接下来固定导管，确认引流。」
en: “It's in place. Next I'll secure the catheter and check the drainage.”
“...Whew. Is it over?”
“This step is over.”
“...Why do you have to emphasize ‘this step’?”

source_zh_CN: 【米田确认引流与监护记录，继续做术区皮肤消毒。】
zh_CN: 【米田确认引流与监护记录，继续做术区皮肤消毒。】
en: [Yoneda confirms drainage and the monitoring records, then proceeds to disinfect the operative skin area.]

source_zh_CN: 「现在要消毒，可能会觉得有点凉。」
zh_CN: 「现在要消毒，可能会觉得有点凉。」
en: “I'll disinfect the skin now. It may feel a little cold.”
“Okay...”
[Mizuho flinches slightly.]
“Eek! It really is cold!”
“Bear with it a little. It won't take long.”
“Bear with this, bear with that...”

source_zh_CN: 【坂口查看准备情况，确认芹香的切口标记。】
zh_CN: 【坂口查看准备情况，确认芹香的切口标记。】
en: [Sakaguchi checks the preparations and confirms Serika's incision marking.]

source_zh_CN: 「切口没问题。米田护士，这边完成后通知我。」
zh_CN: 「切口没问题。米田护士，这边完成后通知我。」
en: “The incision mark is fine. Nurse Yoneda, let me know when you're finished here.”
“Yes, Dr. Sakaguchi.”
“I'll scrub in.”
“...You're leaving, Doctor?”
“To get ready for sterile work. I'll be right back.”

source_zh_CN: 【坂口离开台边。芹香与弘子也按岗位进入刷手、无菌着装流程。米田继续准备，瑞穗看着她忙碌的动作，忍不住开口。】
zh_CN: 【坂口离开台边。芹香与弘子也按岗位进入刷手、无菌着装流程。米田继续准备，瑞穗看着她忙碌的动作，忍不住开口。】
en: [Sakaguchi steps away. Serika and Hiroko also begin scrubbing and sterile gowning for their roles. Watching Yoneda continue her preparations, Mizuho can't help speaking up.]
“Yoneda.”
“Yes?”
“I'm a tiny bit nervous now.”

source_zh_CN: 「我知道。心率比刚进来时快了些。」
zh_CN: 「我知道。心率比刚进来时快了些。」
en: “I know. Your heart rate is a little higher than when you arrived.”
“You can even tell that...?”
“Watching the monitors is my job.”
“...Am I doing badly, then?”

source_zh_CN: 「您一直有配合。紧张和配合是两回事。」
zh_CN: 「您一直有配合。紧张和配合是两回事。」
en: “You've been cooperating. Being nervous and cooperating are different things.”
“...I see.”

source_zh_CN: 「如果需要，我可以提醒千早小姐早点过来陪您。」
zh_CN: 「如果需要，我可以提醒千早小姐早点过来陪您。」
en: “If you need her, I can remind Miss Chihaya to come over sooner.”
“...Please do.”

source_zh_CN: 【手术室更衣区域。留美已经换好刷手服，戴着手术帽和口罩。她替千早找好合适尺寸的刷手服，检查千早的手术帽是否遮好头发。千早换好衣服，对着镜子整理口罩。】
zh_CN: 【手术室更衣区域。留美已经换好刷手服，戴着手术帽和口罩。她替千早找好合适尺寸的刷手服，检查千早的手术帽是否遮好头发。千早换好衣服，对着镜子整理口罩。】
en: [The operating room changing area. Rumi is already in scrubs, a surgical cap, and a mask. She has found properly sized scrubs for Chihaya and checks that Chihaya's cap covers her hair. Now changed, Chihaya adjusts her mask in the mirror.]
“How is it? Does everything fit?”

source_zh_CN: 「合适！可是……我现在看起来真的像手术室护士耶！」
zh_CN: 「合适！可是……我现在看起来真的像手术室护士耶！」
en: “It does! But... I really look like an operating room nurse now!”

source_zh_CN: 「呵呵，只是今天的陪同观察者哦。」
zh_CN: 「呵呵，只是今天的陪同观察者哦。」
en: “Hehe, you're only an accompanying observer today.”
“I know! It just feels so strange.”

source_zh_CN: 【千早抬起双手，看着自己身上的刷手服。】
zh_CN: 【千早抬起双手，看着自己身上的刷手服。】
en: [Chihaya raises both hands and looks down at her scrubs.]

source_zh_CN: 「上周我还躺在那张手术台上，怕得要死……现在居然穿着跟你们差不多的衣服。」
zh_CN: 「上周我还躺在那张手术台上，怕得要死……现在居然穿着跟你们差不多的衣服。」
en: “Last week I was lying on that table, scared to death... Now I'm wearing almost the same clothes as you.”

source_zh_CN: 「你上周可是自己走进手术室的。那时候我就觉得你进步很多了。」
zh_CN: 「你上周可是自己走进手术室的。那时候我就觉得你进步很多了。」
en: “You walked into the operating room yourself last week. I thought you'd made so much progress.”

source_zh_CN: 「你们还不是一左一右地围着我！」
zh_CN: 「你们还不是一左一右地围着我！」
en: “You were still surrounding me on both sides!”

source_zh_CN: 「这是我们最热情的欢迎方式。」
zh_CN: 「这是我们最热情的欢迎方式。」
en: “That's our warmest welcome.”
“...I don't believe you!”

source_zh_CN: 「这次不用担心。没人要把你按到台上。」
zh_CN: 「这次不用担心。没人要把你按到台上。」
en: “No need to worry this time. Nobody's putting you on the table.”

source_zh_CN: 「啊哈哈！对喔。今天终于轮到我站着了。」
zh_CN: 「啊哈哈！对喔。今天终于轮到我站着了。」
en: “Ahaha! Right. It's finally my turn to stand today.”

source_zh_CN: 「不过也不能站太久。你自己的伤口还在恢复。」
zh_CN: 「不过也不能站太久。你自己的伤口还在恢复。」
en: “But not for too long. Your own incision is still healing.”
“Don't worry. I'll sit quietly.”

source_zh_CN: 【留美检查她的口罩，替她把松开的帽缘整理好。】
zh_CN: 【留美检查她的口罩，替她把松开的帽缘整理好。】
en: [Rumi checks her mask and straightens the loose edge of her cap.]
“All right. Ready to go in.”

source_zh_CN: 「……第四次进手术室，居然是这种打扮。」
zh_CN: 「……第四次进手术室，居然是这种打扮。」
en: “...My fourth time in an operating room, and dressed like this.”
“Nervous?”

source_zh_CN: 「……有点。但瑞穗应该比我更紧张吧。」
zh_CN: 「……有点。但瑞穗应该比我更紧张吧。」
en: “...A little. But Mizuho's probably more nervous than I am.”

source_zh_CN: 【两人来到手术室入口附近。坂口刚完成刷手，正在进行下一步无菌着装准备。】
zh_CN: 【两人来到手术室入口附近。坂口刚完成刷手，正在进行下一步无菌着装准备。】
en: [They arrive near the operating room entrance. Sakaguchi has just finished scrubbing and is preparing to gown up.]
“Dr. Sakaguchi!”
“Miss Kuramoto. All changed?”

source_zh_CN: 「嗯！你看！是不是很像那么回事？」
zh_CN: 「嗯！你看！是不是很像那么回事？」
en: “Yep! Look! Don't I look the part?”
“Cap and mask properly on. Good.”

source_zh_CN: 「嘿嘿，我第一次被你这样夸呀！」
zh_CN: 「嘿嘿，我第一次被你这样夸呀！」
en: “Hehe, that's the first time you've praised me like that!”

source_zh_CN: 「先别得意。今天你可是来陪患者的。」
zh_CN: 「先别得意。今天你可是来陪患者的。」
en: “Don't get carried away. You're here to keep a patient company today.”
“I know. I won't touch things.”

source_zh_CN: 「瑞穗在里面等你。她已经开始紧张了。」
zh_CN: 「瑞穗在里面等你。她已经开始紧张了。」
en: “Mizuho's waiting inside. She's starting to get nervous.”
“...Really?”

source_zh_CN: 「嗯。你进去跟她说说话，应该会好些。」
zh_CN: 「嗯。你进去跟她说说话，应该会好些。」
en: “Yes. Going in and talking to her should help.”
“Okay!”

source_zh_CN: 【坂口继续完成无菌着装，留美带千早从规定通道进入手术室。米田已经完成术前准备，瑞穗躺在手术台上，紧绷得几乎不敢动。】
zh_CN: 【坂口继续完成无菌着装，留美带千早从规定通道进入手术室。米田已经完成术前准备，瑞穗躺在手术台上，紧绷得几乎不敢动。】
en: [Sakaguchi continues gowning up. Rumi brings Chihaya into the operating room through the designated route. Yoneda has finished the preoperative preparations. Mizuho lies on the table, so tense she barely dares move.]
“Mizuho!”
“...Ch-Chihaya?”
“I'm here!”
“You... Why are you dressed like that?”

source_zh_CN: 「厉害吧？我现在是你的专属陪同人员！」
zh_CN: 「厉害吧？我现在是你的专属陪同人员！」
en: “Impressive, right? I'm your personal companion now!”

source_zh_CN: 「准确说，是获准在旁边坐着的观察者。」
zh_CN: 「准确说，是获准在旁边坐着的观察者。」
en: “More precisely, an observer permitted to sit beside you.”
“Rumi! Let me be cool for a moment!”

source_zh_CN: 【留美帮千早在指定的非无菌位置坐好。】
zh_CN: 【留美帮千早在指定的非无菌位置坐好。】
en: [Rumi helps Chihaya sit in the designated nonsterile position.]
“...You really came in.”
“Of course. I promised I'd stay with you.”
“...Yeah.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗盯着她的眼睛看了一会儿，轻轻点头。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗盯着她的眼睛看了一会儿，轻轻点头。】
en: [Mizuho looks into her eyes for a moment, then nods gently.]

source_zh_CN: 「那我把千早小姐交给你们啦。米田护士，这边需要的我已经带到了。」
zh_CN: 「那我把千早小姐交给你们啦。米田护士，这边需要的我已经带到了。」
en: “Then I'll leave Miss Chihaya with you. Nurse Yoneda, I've brought everything needed here.”
“Thank you. I'll take over.”

source_zh_CN: 【留美离开这台手术的工作区域。千早留在瑞穗能听见她说话的位置。】
zh_CN: 【留美离开这台手术的工作区域。千早留在瑞穗能听见她说话的位置。】
en: [Rumi leaves this operation's working area. Chihaya stays where Mizuho can hear her.]

source_zh_CN: 【手术团队完成无菌着装及铺单。坂口与芹香就位，弘子站在器械台旁，米田守在监护与巡回岗位。瑞穗看见众人依次站好，肩膀一下绷紧。】
zh_CN: 【手术团队完成无菌着装及铺单。坂口与芹香就位，弘子站在器械台旁，米田守在监护与巡回岗位。瑞穗看见众人依次站好，肩膀一下绷紧。】
en: [The team finishes sterile gowning and draping. Sakaguchi and Serika take their places, Hiroko stands beside the instrument table, and Yoneda remains at her monitoring and circulating station. Watching everyone line up, Mizuho's shoulders tense abruptly.]
“...Chihaya.”
“I'm here.”
“Don't go too far away.”

source_zh_CN: 「不会啦。医生说我可以坐在这里。」
zh_CN: 「不会啦。医生说我可以坐在这里。」
en: “I won't. The doctor said I can sit here.”

source_zh_CN: 「我现在突然觉得……你以前好厉害。」
zh_CN: 「我现在突然觉得……你以前好厉害。」
en: “I'm suddenly thinking... You were amazing before.”
“...Only realizing that now?”
“I haven't finished!”
“Okay, okay. I'm listening.”

source_zh_CN: 【米田核对监护状态和准备记录。】
zh_CN: 【米田核对监护状态和准备记录。】
en: [Yoneda checks the monitors and preparation records.]

source_zh_CN: 「监护稳定，准备完成。导尿引流正常。」
zh_CN: 「监护稳定，准备完成。导尿引流正常。」
en: “Monitoring stable, preparations complete. Catheter draining normally.”
“Initial instrument and dressing count complete.”
“Surface marking checked, draping complete.”

source_zh_CN: 「最后核对。患者支手瑞穗，既定健康腹腔与盆腔开放探查。本人选择不麻醉，术前确认记录齐全。」
zh_CN: 「最后核对。患者支手瑞穗，既定健康腹腔与盆腔开放探查。本人选择不麻醉，术前确认记录齐全。」
en: “Final check. Patient Mizuho Shite, planned open exploration of healthy abdominal and pelvic cavities. No anesthesia by her own choice. Preoperative confirmation records complete.”
“Confirmed.”
“Instruments ready.”
“Incision site matches. Ready to begin.”
“...Wait.”
[Everyone pauses briefly.]
“What is it?”

source_zh_CN: 「我知道我已经答应了……可是你们真的全都准备好了啊？」
zh_CN: 「我知道我已经答应了……可是你们真的全都准备好了啊？」
en: “I know I agreed already... But you're really all ready?”

source_zh_CN: 「是。你需要说什么，现在可以说。」
zh_CN: 「是。你需要说什么，现在可以说。」
en: “Yes. If there's something you need to say, you can say it now.”
“...I-I'll try not to move.”

source_zh_CN: 「你可以叫。身体尽量保持稳定，有不舒服就说清楚。」
zh_CN: 「你可以叫。身体尽量保持稳定，有不舒服就说清楚。」
en: “You can cry out. Keep your body as steady as you can, and explain clearly if something feels wrong.”
“...Understood.”

source_zh_CN: 【千早从非无菌区域伸手，轻轻碰了碰瑞穗放在头侧的手。】
zh_CN: 【千早从非无菌区域伸手，轻轻碰了碰瑞穗放在头侧的手。】
en: [From the nonsterile area, Chihaya reaches out and gently touches Mizuho's hand beside her head.]
“Mizuho, look at me.”
“...Yeah.”

source_zh_CN: 「你要是害怕，就说害怕。我不会笑你的。」
zh_CN: 「你要是害怕，就说害怕。我不会笑你的。」
en: “If you're scared, say so. I won't laugh at you.”
“...You really won't?”
“...At least not right now.”
“Hey!!”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗刚要再吐槽，弘子已把手术刀递给坂口。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗刚要再吐槽，弘子已把手术刀递给坂口。】
en: [Before Mizuho can retort again, Hiroko has handed the scalpel to Sakaguchi.]
“Scalpel.”

source_zh_CN: 【坂口接过器械，开始切开皮肤。】
zh_CN: 【坂口接过器械，开始切开皮肤。】
en: [Sakaguchi takes the instrument and begins the skin incision.]

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗猛地吸了一口气，紧接着发出一声响亮的惨叫。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗猛地吸了一口气，紧接着发出一声响亮的惨叫。】
en: [Mizuho draws a sharp breath, then lets out a loud scream.]
“Aaaaah—!! It hurts!! It really hurts!!”
“Mizuho!”
“Ch-Chihaya! They really cut me!!”
“I know! I know! Just breathe!”

source_zh_CN: 「支手小姐，别把气憋住。先慢慢吐出来。」
zh_CN: 「支手小姐，别把气憋住。先慢慢吐出来。」
en: “Miss Shite, don't hold your breath. Let it out slowly first.”
“I-I can't—Aaaah!”

source_zh_CN: 「可以喊。不要突然抬起身体。跟着我，吸气，慢慢呼。」
zh_CN: 「可以喊。不要突然抬起身体。跟着我，吸气，慢慢呼。」
en: “You can shout. Don't suddenly lift your body. Follow me: breathe in, slowly out.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗断断续续地试着呼气。坂口与芹香继续按计划处理切口，弘子依次交接器械。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗断断续续地试着呼气。坂口与芹香继续按计划处理切口，弘子依次交接器械。】
en: [Mizuho tries to exhale in broken breaths. Sakaguchi and Serika continue working on the incision as planned, while Hiroko passes the instruments in sequence.]
“Serika, maintain exposure here.”
“Understood. View is stable.”
“Next instrument.”

source_zh_CN: 「呜呜……为什么你们还在这么平静地说话啊！」
zh_CN: 「呜呜……为什么你们还在这么平静地说话啊！」
en: “Ugh... Why are you still talking so calmly?!”
“I used to think that too!”

source_zh_CN: 「那你为什么现在也这么平静啦！！」
zh_CN: 「那你为什么现在也这么平静啦！！」
en: “Then why are you so calm now too?!”

source_zh_CN: 「因为我这次不用躺在那里呀！」
zh_CN: 「因为我这次不用躺在那里呀！」
en: “Because I don't have to lie there this time!”
“Chihaya—!!”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗咬紧嘴唇，又因为下一阵疼痛而忍不住喊出声。米田查看监护和导尿情况。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗咬紧嘴唇，又因为下一阵疼痛而忍不住喊出声。米田查看监护和导尿情况。】
en: [Mizuho bites her lip, then cries out again at the next wave of pain. Yoneda checks the monitors and urinary drainage.]

source_zh_CN: 「支手小姐，心跳有点快。疼痛我知道，先听御園医生的节奏呼吸。」
zh_CN: 「支手小姐，心跳有点快。疼痛我知道，先听御園医生的节奏呼吸。」
en: “Miss Shite, your heart rate is a little fast. I know it hurts. Follow Dr. Misono's breathing rhythm first.”
“I'm, already, trying...!”

source_zh_CN: 「我看到您在配合。先不要往上挣。」
zh_CN: 「我看到您在配合。先不要往上挣。」
en: “I can see you're cooperating. Don't try to pull yourself up.”
[Yoneda checks the collection bag and notes the change.]
“Urine output has increased. Noting that down.”
“Wh-what did you just say?!”

source_zh_CN: 「导尿袋里的尿量。我在做监护记录。」
zh_CN: 「导尿袋里的尿量。我在做监护记录。」
en: “The urine in the collection bag. I'm recording the monitoring observations.”
“...I can't even control that anymore?!”

source_zh_CN: 「导尿管本来就会把尿液引出来。您先别分心。」
zh_CN: 「导尿管本来就会把尿液引出来。您先别分心。」
en: “The catheter is meant to drain urine. Try not to get distracted.”
“How could that not distract me?!”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗的脸涨得通红，千早轻轻捏了捏她的手指。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗的脸涨得通红，千早轻轻捏了捏她的手指。】
en: [Mizuho's face turns bright red. Chihaya gently squeezes her fingers.]

source_zh_CN: 「没关系啦。反正现在没人会怪你。」
zh_CN: 「没关系啦。反正现在没人会怪你。」
en: “It's all right. Nobody's blaming you.”
“Stop talking about it!!”
“Mizuho.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗听见芹香突然叫自己的名字，勉强把目光转向她。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗听见芹香突然叫自己的名字，勉强把目光转向她。】
en: [Hearing Serika suddenly use her given name, Mizuho struggles to turn her gaze toward her.]
“Look at Chihaya. She's beside you.”
“...Yeah.”

source_zh_CN: 「呼吸跟得上就好。你已经做到了。」
zh_CN: 「呼吸跟得上就好。你已经做到了。」
en: “Just keep up with the breathing. You're already doing it.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗努力把一口气呼完。坂口与芹香完成切口的初步处理，继续向腹腔内推进探查。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗努力把一口气呼完。坂口与芹香完成切口的初步处理，继续向腹腔内推进探查。】
en: [Mizuho manages to finish exhaling. Sakaguchi and Serika complete the initial work on the incision and continue the exploration into the abdominal cavity.]
“...Dr. Sakaguchi.”
“I'm listening.”
“How much... longer...?”

source_zh_CN: 「现在才刚开始。接下来会按计划逐步检查。」
zh_CN: 「现在才刚开始。接下来会按计划逐步检查。」
en: “We've only just begun. We'll examine everything step by step as planned.”
“...Only just begun?!”
“That's why I told you it was scary...”
“I get it now!!”

source_zh_CN: 【手术继续。坂口与芹香配合调整暴露范围；弘子准备牵开器，米田持续核对监护。】
zh_CN: 【手术继续。坂口与芹香配合调整暴露范围；弘子准备牵开器，米田持续核对监护。】
en: [The operation continues. Sakaguchi and Serika work together to adjust exposure; Hiroko prepares the retractor while Yoneda keeps checking the monitors.]
“Hiroko, retractor.”
“Retractor.”
[Hiroko passes the instrument.]
“...Re-rewhat?”

source_zh_CN: 「需要把切口保持在合适的位置，才能看清楚里面。」
zh_CN: 「需要把切口保持在合适的位置，才能看清楚里面。」
en: “We need to hold the incision in the right position to see clearly inside.”
“Suddenly I don't want to know!”

source_zh_CN: 「瑞穗，等会儿可能有明显的牵拉感。尽量保持身体不动。」
zh_CN: 「瑞穗，等会儿可能有明显的牵拉感。尽量保持身体不动。」
en: “Mizuho, you may feel a strong pulling sensation shortly. Keep as still as you can.”
“...I'm already trying so hard...”

source_zh_CN: 【牵开器安置完成。瑞穗紧紧闭了一会儿眼睛，随后又忍不住睁开。】
zh_CN: 【牵开器安置完成。瑞穗紧紧闭了一会儿眼睛，随后又忍不住睁开。】
en: [The retractor is positioned. Mizuho squeezes her eyes shut for a moment, then can't help opening them again.]
“Aah... This feels so strange...”
“Breathe out. Don't hold it.”
“...Hah, hah...”

source_zh_CN: 【千早坐在非无菌观察位置，原本只顾看瑞穗的脸。她听到医生们讨论术野，忍不住朝那边瞟了一眼。】
zh_CN: 【千早坐在非无菌观察位置，原本只顾看瑞穗的脸。她听到医生们讨论术野，忍不住朝那边瞟了一眼。】
en: [Seated in the nonsterile observation position, Chihaya has been watching only Mizuho's face. Hearing the doctors discuss the operative field, she can't help glancing over.]
“Chihaya?”
“...N-nothing.”
“Where were you just looking?”
“...J-just over where the doctors are.”
“What did you see?”

source_zh_CN: 「我、我好像看见……你的肚子里面……」
zh_CN: 「我、我好像看见……你的肚子里面……」
en: “I-I think I saw... Inside your stomach...”
“What?!!”

source_zh_CN: 「对不起！我不是故意的！就是有点好奇嘛！」
zh_CN: 「对不起！我不是故意的！就是有点好奇嘛！」
en: “Sorry! I didn't mean to! I was just a little curious!”

source_zh_CN: 「这种东西不要随便好奇啊啊啊！！」
zh_CN: 「这种东西不要随便好奇啊啊啊！！」
en: “Don't get casually curious about things like that!!”

source_zh_CN: 【芹香调整手中的牵引，视线始终留在术野。】
zh_CN: 【芹香调整手中的牵引，视线始终留在术野。】
en: [Serika adjusts the traction, keeping her eyes on the operative field.]
“Mizuho, don't turn over.”
“...Okay!”

source_zh_CN: 「小肠位置正常。先按顺序检查上腹部，再看肠系膜和盆腔。」
zh_CN: 「小肠位置正常。先按顺序检查上腹部，再看肠系膜和盆腔。」
en: “Small bowel position is normal. We'll examine the upper abdomen in order, then the mesentery and pelvis.”

source_zh_CN: 「我维持暴露。这里的组织层次清楚。」
zh_CN: 「我维持暴露。这里的组织层次清楚。」
en: “I'll maintain exposure. The tissue planes are clear here.”
“Suction.”
[Hiroko completes the instrument handoff.]
“...Now suction?!”

source_zh_CN: 「是手术要用的东西。听名字吓人，工作的时候很普通呀。」
zh_CN: 「是手术要用的东西。听名字吓人，工作的时候很普通呀。」
en: “It's something we use in surgery. The name sounds scary, but it's ordinary work.”
“Only you think it's ordinary!”

source_zh_CN: 「心率在回落。瑞穗小姐，现在呼吸比刚开始平稳多了。」
zh_CN: 「心率在回落。瑞穗小姐，现在呼吸比刚开始平稳多了。」
en: “Heart rate is coming down. Miss Mizuho, your breathing is much steadier than at the start.”
“...Really?”

source_zh_CN: 「真的。您没有忘记听医生的指令。」
zh_CN: 「真的。您没有忘记听医生的指令。」
en: “Really. You haven't forgotten to follow the doctors' instructions.”
“...So I am doing pretty well, right?”
“Yeah. I'll admit that.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗勉强露出一个小小的得意表情。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗勉强露出一个小小的得意表情。】
en: [Mizuho manages a faintly proud expression.]
“...Hehe.”
[The doctors continue the examination as planned.]

source_zh_CN: 「肝脏表面正常。胆囊没有明显异常。」
zh_CN: 「肝脏表面正常。胆囊没有明显异常。」
en: “Liver surface normal. No obvious gallbladder abnormality.”
“No suspicious changes here either.”

source_zh_CN: 「……你们现在是在给我的器官打分吗？」
zh_CN: 「……你们现在是在给我的器官打分吗？」
en: “...Are you grading my organs now?”
“We're checking for abnormalities.”

source_zh_CN: 「那能不能只告诉我结果好不好？」
zh_CN: 「那能不能只告诉我结果好不好？」
en: “Then can you just tell me whether the results are good?”
“Everything is normal so far.”
“Thank goodness...”

source_zh_CN: 【坂口开始检查肠管及肠系膜的相关部位。芹香调整器械与牵引方向，保证视野。】
zh_CN: 【坂口开始检查肠管及肠系膜的相关部位。芹香调整器械与牵引方向，保证视野。】
en: [Sakaguchi begins examining the bowel and relevant parts of the mesentery. Serika adjusts the instruments and direction of traction to maintain visibility.]
“We need another look here.”
“Mm, I agree.”
“...What now?!”

source_zh_CN: 「只是需要把这部分确认清楚。」
zh_CN: 「只是需要把这部分确认清楚。」
en: “We simply need to confirm this area properly.”

source_zh_CN: 「组织看起来健康。没有发现病变。」
zh_CN: 「组织看起来健康。没有发现病变。」
en: “The tissue looks healthy. No lesions found.”

source_zh_CN: 「……那你们刚才干嘛突然那么认真？」
zh_CN: 「……那你们刚才干嘛突然那么认真？」
en: “...Then why did you suddenly get so serious?”
“Confirming good health requires care too.”
“...That makes so much sense I can't argue.”

source_zh_CN: 【千早听见她还能吐槽，稍稍放松，重新看向医生的工作。】
zh_CN: 【千早听见她还能吐槽，稍稍放松，重新看向医生的工作。】
en: [Hearing that Mizuho can still complain, Chihaya relaxes a little and looks back at the doctors' work.]
“...Amazing.”
“...What's amazing?”

source_zh_CN: 「你看，芹香医生动作特别稳。弘子姐姐递东西也好快。」
zh_CN: 「你看，芹香医生动作特别稳。弘子姐姐递东西也好快。」
en: “Look, Dr. Serika's movements are so steady. And Hiroko passes things so quickly.”

source_zh_CN: 「……你现在是来给他们当啦啦队的吗？」
zh_CN: 「……你现在是来给他们当啦啦队的吗？」
en: “...Are you here to be their cheerleader now?”
“I honestly think they look cool!”
“They're operating on me right now!”

source_zh_CN: 「我知道！所以才觉得你也很厉害呀。」
zh_CN: 「我知道！所以才觉得你也很厉害呀。」
en: “I know! That's why I think you're amazing too.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗怔了一下，艰难地笑了笑。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗怔了一下，艰难地笑了笑。】
en: [Mizuho pauses, then manages a strained smile.]

source_zh_CN: 「……你现在夸我，我也不会原谅你偷看我肚子里面的。」
zh_CN: 「……你现在夸我，我也不会原谅你偷看我肚子里面的。」
en: “...Complimenting me now won't make me forgive you for peeking inside my stomach.”
“Haha! Be mad after you're discharged!”

source_zh_CN: 【手术持续。米田定时核对监护，弘子与两名医生保持稳定的器械交接。瑞穗在疼痛与疲惫中努力遵循芹香的呼吸提示。】
zh_CN: 【手术持续。米田定时核对监护，弘子与两名医生保持稳定的器械交接。瑞穗在疼痛与疲惫中努力遵循芹香的呼吸提示。】
en: [The operation continues. Yoneda checks the monitors regularly, while Hiroko maintains steady instrument exchanges with both doctors. Through pain and fatigue, Mizuho tries to follow Serika's breathing cues.]

source_zh_CN: 【手术进行到盆腔探查阶段。手术室门打开，已经完成刷手、戴好手术帽和口罩、穿着无菌手术袍的阿库娅来到台旁。】
zh_CN: 【手术进行到盆腔探查阶段。手术室门打开，已经完成刷手、戴好手术帽和口罩、穿着无菌手术袍的阿库娅来到台旁。】
en: [The operation has reached the pelvic exploration. The door opens, and Aqua approaches the table, already scrubbed in and wearing a surgical cap, mask, and sterile gown.]
“Thanks for your hard work, everyone! I'm here for a look—”

source_zh_CN: 【阿库娅停住，望向正在进行的探查。】
zh_CN: 【阿库娅停住，望向正在进行的探查。】
en: [Aqua stops, looking at the exploration underway.]
“Wow, you're already this far!”
“...Wh-who's here?”
“...That voice...”

source_zh_CN: 「水城？你不是说今天的手术没什么意思吗？」
zh_CN: 「水城？你不是说今天的手术没什么意思吗？」
en: “Mizuki? Didn't you say today's surgery wasn't interesting?”

source_zh_CN: 「当助手没意思呀。可是健康女孩子的盆腔能在开放手术里这样观察到，机会很难得嘛！」
zh_CN: 「当助手没意思呀。可是健康女孩子的盆腔能在开放手术里这样观察到，机会很难得嘛！」
en: “Assisting wasn't interesting. But seeing a healthy girl's pelvis like this in open surgery is such a rare opportunity!”
“Wait! I'm still awake!”

source_zh_CN: 「啊，瑞穗小姐，早上好！你真有精神！」
zh_CN: 「啊，瑞穗小姐，早上好！你真有精神！」
en: “Oh, Miss Mizuho, good morning! You're so energetic!”

source_zh_CN: 「我都痛成这样了，你从哪里看出来有精神啦？！」
zh_CN: 「我都痛成这样了，你从哪里看出来有精神啦？！」
en: “I'm in this much pain! Where do you see any energy?!”

source_zh_CN: 【芹香抬眼看了阿库娅一下，轻轻摇头。】
zh_CN: 【芹香抬眼看了阿库娅一下，轻轻摇头。】
en: [Serika looks up at Aqua and shakes her head slightly.]

source_zh_CN: 「你来之前，已经跟巡回护士确认过了吧？」
zh_CN: 「你来之前，已经跟巡回护士确认过了吧？」
en: “You checked with the circulating nurse before coming in, didn't you?”

source_zh_CN: 「已确认。水城医生完成无菌准备，作为追加观察人员入室。」
zh_CN: 「已确认。水城医生完成无菌准备，作为追加观察人员入室。」
en: “Confirmed. Dr. Mizuki has completed sterile preparation and entered as an additional observer.”
“All the formalities are done! I won't get in the way!”

source_zh_CN: 「那就从旁边看。不要挡住主刀的视野。」
zh_CN: 「那就从旁边看。不要挡住主刀的视野。」
en: “Then observe from the side. Don't block the surgeon's view.”
“Understood, understood.”

source_zh_CN: 【阿库娅认真观察。坂口与芹香继续检查，弘子按两人的要求交接器械。】
zh_CN: 【阿库娅认真观察。坂口与芹香继续检查，弘子按两人的要求交接器械。】
en: [Aqua observes intently. Sakaguchi and Serika continue examining, with Hiroko passing instruments as requested.]

source_zh_CN: 「好漂亮的正常解剖呀。组织层次这么清楚，真难得。」
zh_CN: 「好漂亮的正常解剖呀。组织层次这么清楚，真难得。」
en: “What beautiful normal anatomy. Such clear tissue planes are a rare sight.”
“...B-beautiful?”

source_zh_CN: 「是呀！健康的时候，各个结构之间的关系特别容易看明白。」
zh_CN: 「是呀！健康的时候，各个结构之间的关系特别容易看明白。」
en: “Yes! When everything is healthy, it's especially easy to see how the structures relate to one another.”
“So now I'm... teaching material?”

source_zh_CN: 「你是正在接受检查的患者。我们在完成你同意的探查。」
zh_CN: 「你是正在接受检查的患者。我们在完成你同意的探查。」
en: “You're a patient undergoing an examination. We're completing the exploration you agreed to.”

source_zh_CN: 「不过你真的很健康耶！我一直想仔细看看这种状态的盆腔。」
zh_CN: 「不过你真的很健康耶！我一直想仔细看看这种状态的盆腔。」
en: “But you really are healthy! I've always wanted a close look at a pelvis in this condition.”

source_zh_CN: 「……我突然不知道该高兴还是该哭了！」
zh_CN: 「……我突然不知道该高兴还是该哭了！」
en: “...Suddenly I don't know whether to be happy or cry!”

source_zh_CN: 「你今天不是一直希望大家夸你身体好吗？」
zh_CN: 「你今天不是一直希望大家夸你身体好吗？」
en: “Haven't you wanted everyone to praise how healthy you are all day?”

source_zh_CN: 「夸身体好和夸肚子里面好看是两回事！！」
zh_CN: 「夸身体好和夸肚子里面好看是两回事！！」
en: “Praising my health and saying the inside of my stomach looks pretty are two different things!!”

source_zh_CN: 【阿库娅看向芹香维持的术野。】
zh_CN: 【阿库娅看向芹香维持的术野。】
en: [Aqua looks at the operative field Serika is maintaining.]

source_zh_CN: 「御園医生，这里已经确认了吗？」
zh_CN: 「御園医生，这里已经确认了吗？」
en: “Dr. Misono, have you checked here already?”
“We're checking the agreed area now.”
“Can I stand a little closer to look?”
“Stand on my side. Don't touch the retractor.”
“Okay!”

source_zh_CN: 【阿库娅挪到芹香允许的位置，探头观察。】
zh_CN: 【阿库娅挪到芹香允许的位置，探头观察。】
en: [Aqua moves to the position Serika allows and leans forward to observe.]
“...Dr. Aqua.”
“Yes?”
“Are you smiling?”
“You can tell with my mask on?”
“I can hear it in your voice!!”

source_zh_CN: 「因为很开心嘛。你这里真的没什么问题，健康是好事呀！」
zh_CN: 「因为很开心嘛。你这里真的没什么问题，健康是好事呀！」
en: “Because I'm happy. There's really nothing wrong here. Being healthy is a good thing!”
“...I'd rather you finished looking quickly...”

source_zh_CN: 【一阵疼痛袭来，瑞穗的声音突然发颤。】
zh_CN: 【一阵疼痛袭来，瑞穗的声音突然发颤。】
en: [A wave of pain makes Mizuho's voice suddenly tremble.]
“Ah... It hurts... Again...”
“Mizuho, breathe out. Slowly.”
“Hah... Hah... I-I know...”
“Hold my hand.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗重新握住千早伸来的手。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗重新握住千早伸来的手。】
en: [Mizuho takes Chihaya's outstretched hand again.]
“...Oh dear, this really is hard on you.”
“You only just noticed?”
“I did notice!”
“You absolutely didn't—!”

source_zh_CN: 【千早忍不住笑了一声，又立刻看向瑞穗。】
zh_CN: 【千早忍不住笑了一声，又立刻看向瑞穗。】
en: [Chihaya can't help letting out a laugh, then immediately looks back at Mizuho.]
“Hang in there, Mizuho. They're nearly finished examining.”
“...Are you sure?”
“...I can't promise that.”
“Then don't sound so certain!!”

source_zh_CN: 【坂口与芹香完成既定范围内的探查。阿库娅在旁认真听取两人的确认，弘子准备检查结束所需的器械。】
zh_CN: 【坂口与芹香完成既定范围内的探查。阿库娅在旁认真听取两人的确认，弘子准备检查结束所需的器械。】
en: [Sakaguchi and Serika finish exploring the agreed area. Aqua listens carefully to their confirmations, while Hiroko prepares the instruments needed to conclude the examination.]

source_zh_CN: 「盆腔各处没有发现异常。检查范围按计划完成了。」
zh_CN: 「盆腔各处没有发现异常。检查范围按计划完成了。」
en: “No abnormalities found throughout the pelvis. The planned examination is complete.”

source_zh_CN: 「确认。没有需要处理或切除的病变。」
zh_CN: 「确认。没有需要处理或切除的病变。」
en: “Confirmed. No lesions requiring treatment or removal.”
“Mm-hmm, completely healthy.”
“...Could all three of you say that again?”
“The examination results are normal.”
“No, no, I want the part before that.”
“No lesions requiring removal.”
“...Thank goodness...!”
“I knew you weren't sick.”

source_zh_CN: 「你不知道！你只知道我会被开刀！」
zh_CN: 「你不知道！你只知道我会被开刀！」
en: “You didn't know! All you knew was that I'd be operated on!”
“...True.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗看向屋顶，松了一口气，又因为身体里的牵拉感皱起眉。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗看向屋顶，松了一口气，又因为身体里的牵拉感皱起眉。】
en: [Mizuho looks at the ceiling and sighs with relief, then frowns at the pulling sensation inside her body.]

source_zh_CN: 「……所以现在能不能把我的肚子关起来了？」
zh_CN: 「……所以现在能不能把我的肚子关起来了？」
en: “...So can you close my stomach now?”

source_zh_CN: 「还需要最后复核，确认止血，再逐层关腹。」
zh_CN: 「还需要最后复核，确认止血，再逐层关腹。」
en: “We still need a final review, confirm hemostasis, and then close the abdomen layer by layer.”
“...Another review?!”

source_zh_CN: 「既然打开检查了，就得好好检查到最后呀。」
zh_CN: 「既然打开检查了，就得好好检查到最后呀。」
en: “Since we've opened you up to check, we have to be thorough to the end.”

source_zh_CN: 「弘子姐，你不要说得像拆开一个包裹一样！」
zh_CN: 「弘子姐，你不要说得像拆开一个包裹一样！」
en: “Hiroko, don't make it sound like opening a parcel!”

source_zh_CN: 「那也是因为你一直催我们快点收工嘛。」
zh_CN: 「那也是因为你一直催我们快点收工嘛。」
en: “Well, you keep telling us to hurry up and finish work.”
“I really do want this work finished!”

source_zh_CN: 【米田查看监护数据，记录各个操作阶段的时间。】
zh_CN: 【米田查看监护数据，记录各个操作阶段的时间。】
en: [Yoneda checks the monitoring data and records the times of the operative stages.]

source_zh_CN: 「患者状态稳定。探查完成时间已记入巡回记录。」
zh_CN: 「患者状态稳定。探查完成时间已记入巡回记录。」
en: “Patient stable. Exploration completion time entered in the circulating record.”
“Good. How are the photo preparations?”

source_zh_CN: 「按既定医疗记录方式可以拍摄。」
zh_CN: 「按既定医疗记录方式可以拍摄。」
en: “We can photograph it using the agreed medical documentation procedure.”
[Sakaguchi turns slightly toward Mizuho.]

source_zh_CN: 「瑞穗。你之前说过想把这次经历留作纪念。」
zh_CN: 「瑞穗。你之前说过想把这次经历留作纪念。」
en: “Mizuho. You said before that you wanted a memento of this experience.”
“...I've said a lot of foolish things. Which one?”

source_zh_CN: 「如果你愿意，可以给探查部位拍一张医学记录照片。留作这次手术的纪念。」
zh_CN: 「如果你愿意，可以给探查部位拍一张医学记录照片。留作这次手术的纪念。」
en: “If you'd like, we can take a medical record photograph of the explored area, as a memento of this operation.”
“...A photo of the inside of my stomach?”

source_zh_CN: 「对。只用于这次安排好的医疗记录与给你本人留存。」
zh_CN: 「对。只用于这次安排好的医疗记录与给你本人留存。」
en: “Yes. Only for the agreed medical record and for you to keep personally.”

source_zh_CN: 「你不是说过想要特别一点的纪念品吗？」
zh_CN: 「你不是说过想要特别一点的纪念品吗？」
en: “Didn't you say you wanted a special souvenir?”
“...That's a little too special...”
[Mizuho takes a couple of breaths.]

source_zh_CN: 「不用现在勉强决定。我们会继续完成后面的操作。」
zh_CN: 「不用现在勉强决定。我们会继续完成后面的操作。」
en: “You don't need to force yourself to decide now. We'll continue with the remaining procedures.”
“Wait.”

source_zh_CN: 【她努力把肩膀放松下来，眼里又浮起熟悉的不服输神色。】
zh_CN: 【她努力把肩膀放松下来，眼里又浮起熟悉的不服输神色。】
en: [She tries to relax her shoulders. That familiar defiance returns to her eyes.]
“...Take it!”
“Are you sure?”

source_zh_CN: 「当、当然啦……都已经开成这样了……不拍不是太亏了吗……！」
zh_CN: 「当、当然啦……都已经开成这样了……不拍不是太亏了吗……！」
en: “O-of course... I'm already opened up like this... Wouldn't it be a waste not to...!”

source_zh_CN: 「哇，瑞穗小姐，你真的很有胆量呢！」
zh_CN: 「哇，瑞穗小姐，你真的很有胆量呢！」
en: “Wow, Miss Mizuho, you really are brave!”
“C-call it the last of my courage...!”

source_zh_CN: 【米田完成拍摄与对应记录。坂口和芹香进行最后复核，弘子继续核对器械。】
zh_CN: 【米田完成拍摄与对应记录。坂口和芹香进行最后复核，弘子继续核对器械。】
en: [Yoneda takes the photograph and completes its record. Sakaguchi and Serika perform the final review while Hiroko continues checking instruments.]
“Photograph documented.”
“Good. Prepare to close.”
“...Whew... Finally...”
“Needle holder and suture. Ready.”
“...Wait. What did you just say...?”
“...Mizuho.”
“...N-no way...”

source_zh_CN: 「接下来是缝合。还需要你再配合一段时间。」
zh_CN: 「接下来是缝合。还需要你再配合一段时间。」
en: “Suturing is next. We'll need your cooperation a little longer.”

source_zh_CN: 「为什么『缝起来』听着一点也不比『切开』轻松啊啊啊！！」
zh_CN: 「为什么『缝起来』听着一点也不比『切开』轻松啊啊啊！！」
en: “Why doesn't ‘sewing me up’ sound any easier than ‘cutting me open’?!”

source_zh_CN: 【检查结束，坂口与芹香开始逐层关腹。弘子准备缝合器械和材料，米田继续记录患者情况。】
zh_CN: 【检查结束，坂口与芹香开始逐层关腹。弘子准备缝合器械和材料，米田继续记录患者情况。】
en: [With the examination complete, Sakaguchi and Serika begin closing the abdomen layer by layer. Hiroko prepares suturing instruments and materials, while Yoneda continues recording the patient's condition.]

source_zh_CN: 「那我想看的部分已经看到了。辛苦啦，瑞穗小姐！」
zh_CN: 「那我想看的部分已经看到了。辛苦啦，瑞穗小姐！」
en: “Well, I've seen the part I wanted. You've worked hard, Miss Mizuho!”
“...Dr. Aqua.”
“Yes?”
“You're just leaving, all satisfied?!”

source_zh_CN: 「因为接下来是关腹嘛。等会儿我还有其他工作。」
zh_CN: 「因为接下来是关腹嘛。等会儿我还有其他工作。」
en: “Because it's closure next. I have other work in a little while.”

source_zh_CN: 「我在这里受了一整天的罪，你却说得像参观结束了一样！」
zh_CN: 「我在这里受了一整天的罪，你却说得像参观结束了一样！」
en: “I've suffered here all day, and you make it sound like the tour's over!”

source_zh_CN: 「下次要是有特别的病例，我也很愿意来帮忙哦！」
zh_CN: 「下次要是有特别的病例，我也很愿意来帮忙哦！」
en: “If there's another unusual case next time, I'd love to help!”
“There won't be a next time!!”

source_zh_CN: 【阿库娅向坂口和芹香打了个招呼，退出无菌工作位置，按流程离开手术室。】
zh_CN: 【阿库娅向坂口和芹香打了个招呼，退出无菌工作位置，按流程离开手术室。】
en: [Aqua says goodbye to Sakaguchi and Serika, steps out of the sterile working position, and leaves the operating room following procedure.]

source_zh_CN: 「瑞穗，准备开始缝合。还有一段时间，呼吸尽量稳一点。」
zh_CN: 「瑞穗，准备开始缝合。还有一段时间，呼吸尽量稳一点。」
en: “Mizuho, we're ready to begin suturing. It'll take a while longer. Keep your breathing as steady as you can.”
“...How long... is a while...?”
“We need to take care of each layer properly.”
“Just how many layers... does ‘each layer’ mean...?”
“Suture.”
[Hiroko passes the suture.]

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗紧紧闭眼，肩膀跟着绷起。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗紧紧闭眼，肩膀跟着绷起。】
en: [Mizuho squeezes her eyes shut, her shoulders tensing.]

source_zh_CN: 「别把气憋住。吸进来，再慢慢吐出去。」
zh_CN: 「别把气憋住。吸进来，再慢慢吐出去。」
en: “Don't hold your breath. Breathe in, then slowly out.”
“...Hah... Ah, it hurts...!”
“Mizuho, look over here.”
“...Chihaya...”

source_zh_CN: 「你刚才都撑过下刀了。现在也可以的。」
zh_CN: 「你刚才都撑过下刀了。现在也可以的。」
en: “You got through the first cut. You can do this too.”
“You make it sound... so easy...”
“I only dare say that because it's you.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗挣扎着笑了一下，手指扣紧千早的手。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗挣扎着笑了一下，手指扣紧千早的手。】
en: [Mizuho struggles to smile, tightening her fingers around Chihaya's hand.]
“...That's not fair.”

source_zh_CN: 【坂口与芹香处理切口的深部层次。弘子配合器械交换。】
zh_CN: 【坂口与芹香处理切口的深部层次。弘子配合器械交换。】
en: [Sakaguchi and Serika work on the deeper layers of the incision. Hiroko assists with instrument exchanges.]
“Checked here. We can continue.”
“Understood. Maintaining traction in this direction.”
“Material for the next stitch is ready.”
“Good.”

source_zh_CN: 【米田查看监护，更新巡回记录。】
zh_CN: 【米田查看监护，更新巡回记录。】
en: [Yoneda checks the monitors and updates the circulating record.]

source_zh_CN: 「患者呼吸比前一阶段平稳。瑞穗小姐，继续保持就好。」
zh_CN: 「患者呼吸比前一阶段平稳。瑞穗小姐，继续保持就好。」
en: “Breathing is steadier than in the previous stage. Miss Mizuho, just keep this up.”
“...You make it sound... like I'm really capable...”
“You've been trying hard all day.”
“...If I'd known it would hurt this much, I would have...”
“You would have?”
“...Had one more delicious meal before coming!”
“You're unbelievable!!”

source_zh_CN: 【千早笑出声，又赶忙用另一只手抹了抹眼角。】
zh_CN: 【千早笑出声，又赶忙用另一只手抹了抹眼角。】
en: [Chihaya laughs, then quickly wipes the corner of her eye with her other hand.]
“Y-you're not crying, are you?”

source_zh_CN: 「谁哭了啦！明明刚才叫得最大声的是你！」
zh_CN: 「谁哭了啦！明明刚才叫得最大声的是你！」
en: “Who's crying?! You're the one who was screaming loudest!”
“...That was because it really hurt...”
“I know.”
[Chihaya's voice softens.]
“...I know.”

source_zh_CN: 【手术持续。坂口处理完一段缝合，芹香检查切口的对合情况。】
zh_CN: 【手术持续。坂口处理完一段缝合，芹香检查切口的对合情况。】
en: [The surgery continues. Sakaguchi finishes a section of suturing, and Serika checks the approximation of the incision.]

source_zh_CN: 「坂口医生，接下来这一段，我也可以完成。」
zh_CN: 「坂口医生，接下来这一段，我也可以完成。」
en: “Dr. Sakaguchi, I can complete this next section too.”
“I know. You've done very well today.”
“I can keep going.”

source_zh_CN: 「我来完成剩下的部分吧。你从开始准备一直做到现在，先去休息。」
zh_CN: 「我来完成剩下的部分吧。你从开始准备一直做到现在，先去休息。」
en: “Let me finish the rest. You've been working since preparation began. Go and rest.”

source_zh_CN: 【芹香看了看切口，又看向坂口。】
zh_CN: 【芹香看了看切口，又看向坂口。】
en: [Serika looks at the incision, then at Sakaguchi.]
“...Understood.”
“You've been a great help today.”
“Everyone worked well together.”

source_zh_CN: 【芹香退开无菌术野，来到瑞穗头侧。瑞穗闭着眼睛，脸色疲惫，嘴唇仍因为疼痛微微发抖。】
zh_CN: 【芹香退开无菌术野，来到瑞穗头侧。瑞穗闭着眼睛，脸色疲惫，嘴唇仍因为疼痛微微发抖。】
en: [Serika steps away from the sterile field and moves to Mizuho's head. Mizuho's eyes are closed, her face exhausted, her lips still trembling slightly with pain.]
“Mizuho.”
“...Dr... Misono...”

source_zh_CN: 「最后这一段交给坂口医生。检查结果很好。」
zh_CN: 「最后这一段交给坂口医生。检查结果很好。」
en: “Dr. Sakaguchi will finish this last part. The examination results are very good.”
“...I know... You've all said it so many times...”

source_zh_CN: 「再坚持一会儿。很快就能休息了。」
zh_CN: 「再坚持一会儿。很快就能休息了。」
en: “Hold on a little longer. You'll be able to rest soon.”

source_zh_CN: 【芹香将仍戴着手套的手轻轻放在瑞穗裸露的肩膀上。】
zh_CN: 【芹香将仍戴着手套的手轻轻放在瑞穗裸露的肩膀上。】
en: [Serika gently rests her still-gloved hand on Mizuho's bare shoulder.]

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗慢慢睁开眼，看着芹香，神情恍惚。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗慢慢睁开眼，看着芹香，神情恍惚。】
en: [Mizuho slowly opens her eyes and looks at Serika, dazed.]
“...D-Dr. Daimon...?”
[Serika freezes for a moment.]
“...What?”
“...I never... fail...?”
[Serika finally can't help smiling.]
“...That's her line.”
“...Hehe... You really look like her...”

source_zh_CN: 「今天的手术会顺利结束。你可以放心。」
zh_CN: 「今天的手术会顺利结束。你可以放心。」
en: “Today's operation will end well. You can rest assured.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗望着芹香难得露出的笑容，轻轻点头。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗望着芹香难得露出的笑容，轻轻点头。】
en: [Looking at Serika's rare smile, Mizuho nods faintly.]

source_zh_CN: 【芹香收回手，向坂口点头，离开手术台旁的无菌工作位置。】
zh_CN: 【芹香收回手，向坂口点头，离开手术台旁的无菌工作位置。】
en: [Serika withdraws her hand, nods to Sakaguchi, and leaves the sterile working position beside the table.]
“Hiroko, let's continue.”
“Yes. Next set of sutures.”

source_zh_CN: 【坂口继续完成剩余的逐层缝合。瑞穗紧握着千早的手，偶尔疼得轻轻叫出声。】
zh_CN: 【坂口继续完成剩余的逐层缝合。瑞穗紧握着千早的手，偶尔疼得轻轻叫出声。】
en: [Sakaguchi continues the remaining layered closure. Mizuho grips Chihaya's hand tightly, occasionally letting out a quiet cry of pain.]
“...Chihaya.”
“Hmm?”

source_zh_CN: 「我现在……好像稍微理解……你为什么每次都那么害怕了。」
zh_CN: 「我现在……好像稍微理解……你为什么每次都那么害怕了。」
en: “Now... I think I understand a little... Why you're so scared every time.”
“...Really?”
“...Yeah. A hundred times scarier... than I imagined.”
“...I've done it three times, you know.”

source_zh_CN: 「……你今天就不要再炫耀次数了嘛……」
zh_CN: 「……你今天就不要再炫耀次数了嘛……」
en: “...Don't brag about the number today...”
“I'm not bragging!”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗又笑了一下，随即因缝合时的牵拉闭紧眼睛。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗又笑了一下，随即因缝合时的牵拉闭紧眼睛。】
en: [Mizuho smiles again, then squeezes her eyes shut at the pulling sensation from the suturing.]
“...Ugh... Still not over...?”
“The last section. Almost done.”
“...Really, this time...?”
“Really, this time.”
“Suture. Final stitch.”
“...I heard that... ‘Final stitch’...!”

source_zh_CN: 【坂口完成最后的缝合，复查切口。】
zh_CN: 【坂口完成最后的缝合，复查切口。】
en: [Sakaguchi completes the final suture and rechecks the incision.]
“Good. Closure complete.”
“...R-really...?”
“Really. The operation is over.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗长长地吐出一口气，眼睛一下子湿了。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗长长地吐出一口气，眼睛一下子湿了。】
en: [Mizuho lets out a long breath, her eyes suddenly filling with tears.]
“...I'm... alive again...”

source_zh_CN: 「你说得像去了一趟鬼门关一样！」
zh_CN: 「你说得像去了一趟鬼门关一样！」
en: “You make it sound like you went to death's door!”
“...You try lying here once...”
“I've already done it three times!!”

source_zh_CN: 【千早与瑞穗对望了一眼，同时笑了起来。】
zh_CN: 【千早与瑞穗对望了一眼，同时笑了起来。】
en: [Chihaya and Mizuho look at each other and laugh together.]

source_zh_CN: 【弘子与米田进行器械、针具及敷料最终清点，核对记录。】
zh_CN: 【弘子与米田进行器械、针具及敷料最终清点，核对记录。】
en: [Hiroko and Yoneda perform the final instrument, needle, and dressing counts and check the records.]

source_zh_CN: 「器械、针具、敷料清点，数量相符。」
zh_CN: 「器械、针具、敷料清点，数量相符。」
en: “Instrument, needle, and dressing counts correct.”

source_zh_CN: 「巡回记录已核对。患者情况稳定，准备术后转运。」
zh_CN: 「巡回记录已核对。患者情况稳定，准备术后转运。」
en: “Circulating record checked. Patient stable. Preparing postoperative transfer.”
“Confirmed. Thank you, everyone.”

source_zh_CN: 「瑞穗小姐，恭喜。第一次手术结束了。」
zh_CN: 「瑞穗小姐，恭喜。第一次手术结束了。」
en: “Congratulations, Miss Mizuho. Your first surgery is over.”
“...Hiroko.”
“Yes?”

source_zh_CN: 「……你以后再夸我性感的时候……可不可以换个地方……」
zh_CN: 「……你以后再夸我性感的时候……可不可以换个地方……」
en: “...Next time you call me sexy... Could you do it somewhere else...?”
[Hiroko pauses, then laughs.]
“Of course. Next time I'll compliment you in your room.”
“...Haha... It's a deal...”

source_zh_CN: 【米田确认敷料与转运准备，千早缓缓松开瑞穗的手。】
zh_CN: 【米田确认敷料与转运准备，千早缓缓松开瑞穗的手。】
en: [Yoneda checks the dressing and transfer preparations. Chihaya slowly releases Mizuho's hand.]
“I'll wait for you back in the ward.”
“...Make sure you're there.”
“Of course!”

source_zh_CN: 「瑞穗，接下来先休息。我们会继续观察你的恢复情况。」
zh_CN: 「瑞穗，接下来先休息。我们会继续观察你的恢复情况。」
en: “Mizuho, rest now. We'll keep monitoring your recovery.”
“...Okay... Dr. Sakaguchi...”
“What is it?”

source_zh_CN: 「……拍的那张照片……别忘记给我看……」
zh_CN: 「……拍的那张照片……别忘记给我看……」
en: “...That photo... Don't forget to show me...”
“I won't forget.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗闭上眼睛，嘴角终于重新浮起一点笑意。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗闭上眼睛，嘴角终于重新浮起一点笑意。】
en: [Mizuho closes her eyes. At last, a faint smile returns to her lips.]

source_zh_CN: 【周二上午九点。瑞穗的病房。瑞穗已经醒来，正小心地试着挪动上身。朝仓在床边查看护理记录。】
zh_CN: 【周二上午九点。瑞穗的病房。瑞穗已经醒来，正小心地试着挪动上身。朝仓在床边查看护理记录。】
en: [Tuesday, 9:00 a.m., in Mizuho's room. Awake now, Mizuho carefully tries to shift her upper body. Asakura checks the nursing record at her bedside.]
“...Ah, ow, ow, ow!”

source_zh_CN: 「慢一点。昨天刚做完手术，今天起身要人帮忙。」
zh_CN: 「慢一点。昨天刚做完手术，今天起身要人帮忙。」
en: “Slowly. You only had surgery yesterday. You'll need help getting up today.”
“I just wanted to sit a little higher...”

source_zh_CN: 「昨天之前是谁说，自己一定恢复得比千早小姐还快？」
zh_CN: 「昨天之前是谁说，自己一定恢复得比千早小姐还快？」
en: “Who was saying before yesterday that she'd recover faster than Miss Chihaya?”

source_zh_CN: 「……昨天之前的我说过很多不负责任的话。」
zh_CN: 「……昨天之前的我说过很多不负责任的话。」
en: “...The me from before yesterday said a lot of irresponsible things.”

source_zh_CN: 【朝仓看着她，忍不住笑了一下。】
zh_CN: 【朝仓看着她，忍不住笑了一下。】
en: [Asakura looks at her and can't help smiling.]
“At least you remember clearly.”
“I haven't lost my memory!”

source_zh_CN: 【敲门声响起。坂口与芹香进入病房。】
zh_CN: 【敲门声响起。坂口与芹香进入病房。】
en: [A knock sounds. Sakaguchi and Serika enter.]

source_zh_CN: 「早上好，瑞穗。今天感觉怎么样？」
zh_CN: 「早上好，瑞穗。今天感觉怎么样？」
en: “Good morning, Mizuho. How are you feeling today?”
“...Dr. Sakaguchi, good morning!”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗试图像周五那样爽朗地挥手，却立刻牵动腹部，皱起眉头。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗试图像周五那样爽朗地挥手，却立刻牵动腹部，皱起眉头。】
en: [Mizuho tries to wave as brightly as she did on Friday, but immediately pulls at her abdomen and frowns.]
“Smaller movements.”
“They're already small...”
“Good morning. How did you sleep last night?”
“...Dr. Misono.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗看到芹香，忽然想起昨天下刀前那张冷峻的脸，条件反射般收紧肩膀。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗看到芹香，忽然想起昨天下刀前那张冷峻的脸，条件反射般收紧肩膀。】
en: [Seeing Serika, Mizuho suddenly remembers her cold, stern face before yesterday's incision. Her shoulders reflexively tighten.]
“Oh! Nothing! I slept all right!”

source_zh_CN: 「夜里醒过几次。疼痛和伤口的状态都已记录。」
zh_CN: 「夜里醒过几次。疼痛和伤口的状态都已记录。」
en: “She woke several times during the night. Her pain and wound condition have been recorded.”
“Let me see.”

source_zh_CN: 【坂口核对记录。芹香走到床边，检查瑞穗的恢复情况和敷料。】
zh_CN: 【坂口核对记录。芹香走到床边，检查瑞穗的恢复情况和敷料。】
en: [Sakaguchi checks the record. Serika approaches the bed to examine Mizuho's recovery and dressing.]

source_zh_CN: 「现在先躺好。我要看一下伤口周围。」
zh_CN: 「现在先躺好。我要看一下伤口周围。」
en: “Lie back properly for now. I'll look around the wound.”
“...Okay.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗安静下来，任芹香进行检查。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗安静下来，任芹香进行检查。】
en: [Mizuho settles down and lets Serika examine her.]

source_zh_CN: 「恢复情况不错。敷料保持得很好。」
zh_CN: 「恢复情况不错。敷料保持得很好。」
en: “Recovery looks good. The dressing has been kept in good condition.”
“...Dr. Misono.”
“Yes?”
“You sound... gentler today than yesterday.”
“Yesterday we were operating.”

source_zh_CN: 「所以昨天那个特别可怕的表情，是工作用的吗？！」
zh_CN: 「所以昨天那个特别可怕的表情，是工作用的吗？！」
en: “So that really scary face yesterday was your work face?!”

source_zh_CN: 「……需要认真看术野的时候，我就是那个表情。」
zh_CN: 「……需要认真看术野的时候，我就是那个表情。」
en: “...That's my expression when I need to concentrate on the operative field.”

source_zh_CN: 「原来如此。那我以后看到你那个表情，就知道自己有麻烦了。」
zh_CN: 「原来如此。那我以后看到你那个表情，就知道自己有麻烦了。」
en: “I see. So when I see that face again, I'll know I'm in trouble.”

source_zh_CN: 「恐怕也不一定。她昨天检查的是一个非常健康的患者。」
zh_CN: 「恐怕也不一定。她昨天检查的是一个非常健康的患者。」
en: “Not necessarily. Yesterday she was examining a very healthy patient.”
“Ahaha... True.”

source_zh_CN: 【芹香调整好敷料，拉平瑞穗身侧的毯子。】
zh_CN: 【芹香调整好敷料，拉平瑞穗身侧的毯子。】
en: [Serika adjusts the dressing and smooths the blanket beside Mizuho.]

source_zh_CN: 「没有异常。接下来按计划恢复。」
zh_CN: 「没有异常。接下来按计划恢复。」
en: “Nothing abnormal. Continue recovering as planned.”

source_zh_CN: 「……那个，伤口以后会变成什么样？」
zh_CN: 「……那个，伤口以后会变成什么样？」
en: “...Um, what will the wound look like later?”

source_zh_CN: 「近期会有痕迹，需要按护理安排恢复。以后会慢慢淡下去。」
zh_CN: 「近期会有痕迹，需要按护理安排恢复。以后会慢慢淡下去。」
en: “There'll be a mark for a while. Follow the care plan as you recover. It will fade gradually.”

source_zh_CN: 「能淡到穿泳衣也不太明显吗？」
zh_CN: 「能淡到穿泳衣也不太明显吗？」
en: “Enough that it won't be very noticeable in a swimsuit?”

source_zh_CN: 「切口对合得很好。你按要求护理，恢复后痕迹会很不显眼。」
zh_CN: 「切口对合得很好。你按要求护理，恢复后痕迹会很不显眼。」
en: “The incision edges are well aligned. With the prescribed care, the mark will be very faint once you've recovered.”
“...Thank goodness.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗松了一口气，又忽然抬起头。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗松了一口气，又忽然抬起头。】
en: [Mizuho sighs with relief, then suddenly raises her head.]

source_zh_CN: 「不对，我有一个更重要的问题。」
zh_CN: 「不对，我有一个更重要的问题。」
en: “Wait, I have a more important question.”
“Go ahead.”

source_zh_CN: 「我昨天那张照片呢？就是我的器官都很健康的那张！」
zh_CN: 「我昨天那张照片呢？就是我的器官都很健康的那张！」
en: “Where's yesterday's photo? The one of my perfectly healthy organs!”

source_zh_CN: 「您醒来以后已经问过两次了。」
zh_CN: 「您醒来以后已经问过两次了。」
en: “You've asked twice since waking up.”

source_zh_CN: 「这可是我花钱开刀得到的珍贵纪念！当然要问啦！」
zh_CN: 「这可是我花钱开刀得到的珍贵纪念！当然要问啦！」
en: “It's a precious souvenir from the surgery I paid for! Of course I'd ask!”

source_zh_CN: 「拍摄与记录都完成了。等整理好再给你确认。」
zh_CN: 「拍摄与记录都完成了。等整理好再给你确认。」
en: “The photography and documentation are done. Once it's organized, we'll show you.”
“Yay!”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗正想开心地坐起来，看到朝仓的表情，又乖乖靠回枕头。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗正想开心地坐起来，看到朝仓的表情，又乖乖靠回枕头。】
en: [Mizuho starts to sit up happily, sees Asakura's expression, and obediently leans back against her pillow.]
“...I know. Slowly.”
“You learned quickly this time.”

source_zh_CN: 【芹香把检查用的物品整理好。】
zh_CN: 【芹香把检查用的物品整理好。】
en: [Serika puts the examination supplies in order.]
“...Dr. Misono.”
“Yes?”

source_zh_CN: 「昨天真的好痛。特别是你开始画线的时候，我才发现大家来真的。」
zh_CN: 「昨天真的好痛。特别是你开始画线的时候，我才发现大家来真的。」
en: “It really hurt yesterday. Especially when you started drawing that line—that was when I realized everyone meant business.”
“You cooperated very well.”
“...Did I? I was screaming so loudly.”

source_zh_CN: 「叫得大声，和配合手术是两回事。」
zh_CN: 「叫得大声，和配合手术是两回事。」
en: “Screaming loudly and cooperating with surgery are separate things.”

source_zh_CN: 「你一直跟着呼吸，关键的时候也没有乱动。我看得到。」
zh_CN: 「你一直跟着呼吸，关键的时候也没有乱动。我看得到。」
en: “You kept following the breathing cues, and didn't move at critical moments. I could see that.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗愣了愣，随即露出一点羞涩又得意的笑。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗愣了愣，随即露出一点羞涩又得意的笑。】
en: [Mizuho pauses, then smiles with a mixture of shyness and pride.]

source_zh_CN: 「……被你这么一说，我突然觉得自己还挺帅的。」
zh_CN: 「……被你这么一说，我突然觉得自己还挺帅的。」
en: “...When you put it that way, I suddenly feel pretty cool.”
“You can think of it that way.”
“You did hold on until the end.”
“Hehe... That's good, then.”
[Mizuho looks at Serika again.]
“And at the end yesterday...”
“At the end?”

source_zh_CN: 「……你笑了吧？我喊你『大门医生』的时候。」
zh_CN: 「……你笑了吧？我喊你『大门医生』的时候。」
en: “...You smiled, didn't you? When I called you ‘Dr. Daimon.’”
[Serika pauses briefly.]

source_zh_CN: 「……你当时还有精神记住这种事？」
zh_CN: 「……你当时还有精神记住这种事？」
en: “...You still had the energy to remember that?”

source_zh_CN: 「这种事怎么会忘记！你昨天一整天都那么严肃，就那一下真的像大门未知子！」
zh_CN: 「这种事怎么会忘记！你昨天一整天都那么严肃，就那一下真的像大门未知子！」
en: “How could I forget! You were so serious all day, but for that one moment you really looked like Michiko Daimon!”
“So that's what happened.”

source_zh_CN: 「对吧！而且还拍拍我的肩膀，太帅了！」
zh_CN: 「对吧！而且还拍拍我的肩膀，太帅了！」
en: “Right! And you patted my shoulder too. So cool!”
[Serika looks away slightly.]
“...Watch a little less television.”
“You didn't deny smiling!”

source_zh_CN: 【朝仓抿着嘴，忍住笑意。坂口合上记录。】
zh_CN: 【朝仓抿着嘴，忍住笑意。坂口合上记录。】
en: [Asakura presses her lips together to keep from laughing. Sakaguchi closes the record.]

source_zh_CN: 「好了。今天的情况不错。接下来先把恢复做好，别急着和千早比赛下床速度。」
zh_CN: 「好了。今天的情况不错。接下来先把恢复做好，别急着和千早比赛下床速度。」
en: “All right. You're doing well today. Focus on recovering now. Don't rush to race Chihaya out of bed.”
“...I actually was going to compete.”
“I'll keep an eye on her.”
“Tell Nurse Asakura if anything feels wrong.”
“I know. Thank you, Dr. Misono.”
“Mm. Rest well.”

source_zh_CN: 【坂口与芹香向朝仓交代完后续观察事项，准备离开病房。】
zh_CN: 【坂口与芹香向朝仓交代完后续观察事项，准备离开病房。】
en: [Sakaguchi and Serika finish giving Asakura the follow-up observation instructions and prepare to leave.]

source_zh_CN: 【病房门刚打开，千早便探进头来。她仍穿着住院服，走路比前几天稳当多了。】
zh_CN: 【病房门刚打开，千早便探进头来。她仍穿着住院服，走路比前几天稳当多了。】
en: [As the door opens, Chihaya peeks in. Still in her patient clothes, she walks much more steadily than a few days ago.]
“...Can I come in?”
“Chihaya! Come in!”
“Good morning, Dr. Sakaguchi, Dr. Misono!”

source_zh_CN: 「早上好。你自己的恢复也别忘了。」
zh_CN: 「早上好。你自己的恢复也别忘了。」
