en: “Good morning. Don't forget your own recovery.”

source_zh_CN: 「我知道啦！我只是来看看瑞穗！」
zh_CN: 「我知道啦！我只是来看看瑞穗！」
en: “I know! I'm just here to see Mizuho!”
“Walk slowly.”

source_zh_CN: 「……御園医生，你们怎么现在都要叮嘱我走慢一点啊？」
zh_CN: 「……御園医生，你们怎么现在都要叮嘱我走慢一点啊？」
en: “...Dr. Misono, why does everyone keep telling me to walk slowly now?”

source_zh_CN: 「因为你从门口冲进来的样子根本不像刚做过手术的病人呀！」
zh_CN: 「因为你从门口冲进来的样子根本不像刚做过手术的病人呀！」
en: “Because the way you rushed through the door didn't look like someone who'd just had surgery!”
“That's because you shouted for me so loudly!”

source_zh_CN: 【坂口和芹香离开，朝仓也回护士站处理工作。千早拉了把椅子，在瑞穗床边坐下。】
zh_CN: 【坂口和芹香离开，朝仓也回护士站处理工作。千早拉了把椅子，在瑞穗床边坐下。】
en: [Sakaguchi and Serika leave. Asakura returns to work at the nurses' station. Chihaya pulls up a chair beside Mizuho's bed and sits down.]
“How is it? Feeling okay today?”
“...Still alive.”
“Pfft!”

source_zh_CN: 「你笑什么啦！我昨天真的以为自己要完蛋了！」
zh_CN: 「你笑什么啦！我昨天真的以为自己要完蛋了！」
en: “What are you laughing at?! I really thought I was done for yesterday!”

source_zh_CN: 「我可是周五就跟你说很可怕了。」
zh_CN: 「我可是周五就跟你说很可怕了。」
en: “I told you on Friday how scary it was.”
“...You did. So many times!”

source_zh_CN: 「是谁说自己绝对不会像我那样怕的？」
zh_CN: 「是谁说自己绝对不会像我那样怕的？」
en: “Who said she absolutely wouldn't be scared like me?”
“Who said she absolutely wouldn't scream?”
“...Also me.”

source_zh_CN: 「那昨天那个『啊啊啊啊——！』是哪里来的？」
zh_CN: 「那昨天那个『啊啊啊啊——！』是哪里来的？」
en: “Then where did yesterday's ‘Aaaaah—!’ come from?”
“Chi-ha-ya—!!”

source_zh_CN: 【千早笑得前仰后合，随即按了按自己仍在恢复中的腹部。】
zh_CN: 【千早笑得前仰后合，随即按了按自己仍在恢复中的腹部。】
en: [Chihaya rocks with laughter, then presses a hand to her still-recovering abdomen.]

source_zh_CN: 「啊，痛痛痛……不可以笑这么大声……」
zh_CN: 「啊，痛痛痛……不可以笑这么大声……」
en: “Ah, ow, ow... I can't laugh that hard...”
“Serves you right! You're not fully recovered either!”
“...Looks like we're about even now.”

source_zh_CN: 「……对哦。你这边还在恢复，我这边刚开完刀。」
zh_CN: 「……对哦。你这边还在恢复，我这边刚开完刀。」
en: “...True. You're still recovering, and I've just had surgery.”

source_zh_CN: 【两个人安静了一下，又一齐笑了。】
zh_CN: 【两个人安静了一下，又一齐笑了。】
en: [They fall quiet briefly, then laugh together again.]
“But you really were amazing yesterday.”

source_zh_CN: 「……你昨天不是一直看我笑话吗？」
zh_CN: 「……你昨天不是一直看我笑话吗？」
en: “...Weren't you watching me make a fool of myself all day?”
“No! I was worried about you too.”
“...I know.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗低头看着毯子上的褶皱。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗低头看着毯子上的褶皱。】
en: [Mizuho looks down at the folds in her blanket.]

source_zh_CN: 「昨天第一次下刀的时候，我脑子里全是『完了，我为什么要选不麻醉』。」
zh_CN: 「昨天第一次下刀的时候，我脑子里全是『完了，我为什么要选不麻醉』。」
en: “When the first cut came yesterday, all I could think was, ‘I'm doomed. Why did I choose no anesthesia?’”
“...And then?”

source_zh_CN: 「然后你一直在旁边。每次我想闭上眼睛乱叫，就听见你跟我说话。」
zh_CN: 「然后你一直在旁边。每次我想闭上眼睛乱叫，就听见你跟我说话。」
en: “And then you were beside me the whole time. Every time I wanted to shut my eyes and just scream, I heard you talking to me.”
“...Yeah.”

source_zh_CN: 「我以前总觉得，你实在太容易害怕了。我现在才知道，明明害怕成那样，还要一次又一次走进手术室……其实很厉害。」
zh_CN: 「我以前总觉得，你实在太容易害怕了。我现在才知道，明明害怕成那样，还要一次又一次走进手术室……其实很厉害。」
en: “I always thought you got scared far too easily. Now I realize that going into the operating room again and again, when you're that frightened... Is actually amazing.”
[Chihaya freezes.]
“...Why are you suddenly saying that?”
“Am I not allowed?”
“It's not that... It's just a little embarrassing.”

source_zh_CN: 「我昨天比你勇敢的地方还是有的！」
zh_CN: 「我昨天比你勇敢的地方还是有的！」
en: “There were still ways I was braver than you yesterday!”
“You're competing again?!”
“At least I didn't run away once!”

source_zh_CN: 「你是在已经固定好的手术台上才开始害怕的嘛！」
zh_CN: 「你是在已经固定好的手术台上才开始害怕的嘛！」
en: “You only started getting scared after you were already secured on the table!”
“...I suppose I did.”

source_zh_CN: 「而且我第三次也没跑！我可是自己走进去的！」
zh_CN: 「而且我第三次也没跑！我可是自己走进去的！」
en: “And I didn't run the third time either! I walked in myself!”
“Okay, okay, you were super brave the third time!”
“You sound like you're humoring a little kid!!”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗弯起眼睛，笑得格外得意。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗弯起眼睛，笑得格外得意。】
en: [Mizuho's eyes curve into a particularly smug smile.]
“...But there is one thing you're really better at.”
“...What?”

source_zh_CN: 「你昨天穿着刷手服坐在我旁边，完全一副老手的样子。要是换成我，我可能根本不敢再进手术室。」
zh_CN: 「你昨天穿着刷手服坐在我旁边，完全一副老手的样子。要是换成我，我可能根本不敢再进手术室。」
en: “Sitting beside me in scrubs yesterday, you looked like an old hand. If it were me, I might not dare enter an operating room again.”

source_zh_CN: 「……我其实也很紧张呀。看到手术台，心里还是会抖一下。」
zh_CN: 「……我其实也很紧张呀。看到手术台，心里还是会抖一下。」
en: “...I was actually nervous too. Seeing the operating table still makes my heart jump.”
“Then why did you come?”
“Because you were there.”
[Mizuho has no reply for a moment.]

source_zh_CN: 「你前面一直陪着我。这次换我陪你，有什么奇怪的？」
zh_CN: 「你前面一直陪着我。这次换我陪你，有什么奇怪的？」
en: “You stayed with me before. What's strange about it being my turn?”
“...Nothing at all.”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗伸出手。千早握住她的手，两人静静坐了一会儿。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗伸出手。千早握住她的手，两人静静坐了一会儿。】
en: [Mizuho reaches out. Chihaya takes her hand, and they sit quietly for a while.]

source_zh_CN: 「……我明明是来陪你住院的。结果昨天倒是你陪了我一整天。」
zh_CN: 「……我明明是来陪你住院的。结果昨天倒是你陪了我一整天。」
en: “...I came here to keep you company in the hospital. Instead, you spent the whole day with me yesterday.”
“Isn't that nice? We take turns.”
“...Hmph. I'll count this one as your win.”
“Why does even this have to have a winner?!”
[A moment later, Chihaya suddenly remembers something.]

source_zh_CN: 「对了！下周一我们是不是就能一起出院了？」
zh_CN: 「对了！下周一我们是不是就能一起出院了？」
en: “Oh! We can leave together next Monday, right?”

source_zh_CN: 「按安排是这样呀。到时候可得好好庆祝！」
zh_CN: 「按安排是这样呀。到时候可得好好庆祝！」
en: “That's the plan. We'll have to celebrate properly!”
“After what you went through yesterday, you still want to celebrate?”

source_zh_CN: 「当然！我现在有一张谁都没有的肚子里面的照片耶！」
zh_CN: 「当然！我现在有一张谁都没有的肚子里面的照片耶！」
en: “Of course! Now I have a photo of the inside of my stomach that nobody else has!”

source_zh_CN: 「拜托，你不要把那个带去餐厅给人看啦！」
zh_CN: 「拜托，你不要把那个带去餐厅给人看啦！」
en: “Please don't take that to a restaurant to show people!”
“I'll decide based on your reaction.”
“Don't you dare!!”

source_zh_CN: 【瑞穗笑了一阵，忍不住小心地按住毯子。】
zh_CN: 【瑞穗笑了一阵，忍不住小心地按住毯子。】
en: [Mizuho laughs for a while, then carefully presses a hand against the blanket.]
“...Ah, I can't laugh that hard.”
“Haha, even that's the same for us.”
“...Chihaya.”
“What?”

source_zh_CN: 「等出院以后……我们先去吃顿好吃的吧。」
zh_CN: 「等出院以后……我们先去吃顿好吃的吧。」
en: “Once we're discharged... Let's have a good meal first.”
“Sure. What do you want?”

source_zh_CN: 「什么都行，只要不用听见『手术刀』『牵开器』『缝合针』就好。」
zh_CN: 「什么都行，只要不用听见『手术刀』『牵开器』『缝合针』就好。」
en: “Anything, as long as I don't have to hear ‘scalpel,’ ‘retractor,’ or ‘suture needle.’”

source_zh_CN: 「那下次去餐厅，我点菜之前先做一次术前暂停。」
zh_CN: 「那下次去餐厅，我点菜之前先做一次术前暂停。」
en: “Then next time we're at a restaurant, I'll call a surgical time-out before ordering.”
“Don't you dare!!”

source_zh_CN: 【两人的笑声停下来之后，千早仍坐在床边陪着瑞穗。瑞穗小心地调整靠枕，神色终于恢复几分周五入院时的明朗。】
zh_CN: 【两人的笑声停下来之后，千早仍坐在床边陪着瑞穗。瑞穗小心地调整靠枕，神色终于恢复几分周五入院时的明朗。】
en: [After their laughter subsides, Chihaya remains at the bedside with Mizuho. Mizuho carefully adjusts her pillow, finally regaining some of the brightness she had when admitted on Friday.]
